articles.title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
articles.abstract: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.
articles.titleCn: 安全主管：学习型注意力门控可提高提示注入的鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了安全主管（HoS），这是一种通过一组学习到的每个头的注意力门来强制执行指令-数据分离的提示注入防御方法。HoS学习每个头如何在可信和不可信标记之间重新分配注意力，使模型能够在不遵循注入指令的情况下对不可信内容进行推理。我们在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct和GPT-OSS-20B上评估了HoS。我们将其与SecAlign++（一种基于微调的最先进防御）和ASIDE（一种像我们一样将指令-数据分离构建到模型架构中的防御）进行了比较。我们表明，HoS对自适应攻击具有更高的鲁棒性，在标准效用基准测试中表现更好，并在标准代理提示注入基准测试中达到顶尖性能。更具体地说，黑盒RL-Hammer攻击对GPT-OSS-20B的ASR达到97%，对SecAlign达到85%，但对HoS仅为10%。Claudini（一种最先进的白盒攻击）通过自研究强化了对HoS的攻击，达到与GPT-OSS-20B或SecAlign相同的ASR所需的FLOPs是其三倍。HoS在标准多项选择基准测试和提示设置中保留了基础模型的效用，而SecAlign和ASIDE在少样本设置中性能下降。在具有静态攻击的代理基准测试中，HoS和SecAlign表现相似，并显著改善了与基础模型的安全-效用权衡。ASIDE在工具使用方面表现不佳，效用仅为10%。这些结果表明，通过有针对性的注意力干预，可以实现和改进提示注入的鲁棒性。

articles.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
articles.titleCn: GEPA-策展者：为自我改进智能体进行策展式学习
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于需要与复杂环境持续交互的多轮智能体工作负载。现有的反思式提示优化器（如GEPA）通过从失败的推进中学习，但智能体失败也可能源于提示弱点、利用限制、随机执行或噪声裁判。我们认为此类失败可能无法提供有用的学习信号，甚至可能有害；因此，筛选提供给提示优化器的任务以获得更好的性能至关重要。我们引入了GEPA-Curator，这是一个增强提示优化器的框架，用于选择哪些智能体体验应塑造提示优化。具体而言，GEPA-Curator由两个组件组成：任务筛选，用于过滤掉可能提供噪声或不可靠学习信号的任务；以及先验成功检索，它选择性地检索任务的过去成功轨迹，并将它们作为附加上下文提供给提示优化器。我们在GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld和$τ$-bench上评估了GEPA-Curator，使用Gemini 3.1 Pro和Claude Opus 5作为优化器模型。GEPA-Curator的性能与两个基线相当或超过其平均水平，相较于GEPA提升了高达20.7%，相较于ACE提升了21.2%。

articles.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
articles.abstract: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.
articles.titleCn: LLMs能否通过自由探索揭示隐藏的物理定律？
articles.abstractCn: 科学发现往往始于一个出乎意料的观察，从而引出一个新的研究问题。在一个物理定律被改变的世界里，大型语言模型（LLM）能否注意到出乎意料的行为，例如重物下落得更慢，并通过实验发现规律，而无需被告知要研究什么？为了评估这种能力，我们引入了LongChang，这是一个自动化框架，用于创建物理定律被改变的模拟世界，其中一个或多个定律与普通物理不同。被评估的LLM充当探险者，通过操纵物体和建造工具来研究他们自己的问题，而无需研究任务或关于这些定律的提示。独立的LLM代理生成和审查场景，审查工具设计，并使用被改变的物理定律和探索记录来评估报告的正确性和实验支持。这些记录指导场景的进一步探索，使整个周期可以在无人干预的情况下运行。在12个LLM中，GPT-6-Astra实现了16.7%的发现率，而其他11个得分为0%。探索记录揭示了未研究的异常现象，并且仅部分识别了被改变的物理定律。

articles.title: Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing
articles.abstract: Self-attention plays a key role in long-sequence modeling, but its quadratic time complexity fundamentally limits the scaling of Large Language Models. Recently, Multi-State Linear Attention (MSLA) mechanisms have been proposed to make sequence modeling more efficient by splitting the context into segments and compressing each in its own memory state. MSLA aggregates the information extracted from each memory state using only the mean alignment between a query and each segment's keys, ignoring how the alignment is distributed within the segment. In order to model the relevance of a segment to a query more comprehensively and incorporate the variance of the alignment in the aggregation, we propose MERLIN (MomEnt Routing for multi-state LINear attention), a method that tracks the first and second moments of each segment's keys. Using the moments of keys, a query can recover both the mean and the variance of its alignment with each segment to perform a more content-aware aggregation of per-state readouts. Experiments on multi-state variants of Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and Mamba-2-780M show that MERLIN consistently outperforms existing aggregation methods on various long-context tasks. In particular, MERLIN outperforms baselines on RULER needle-in-a-haystack and long-context QA (+8.3% for Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and +7.0% for Mamba-2-780M) and diverse subtasks in LongBench (+13.5% and +12.0%). It even outperforms baselines that consume 4x more memory. MERLIN provides a simple and general routing mechanism for improving long-context capabilities of MSLA models.
articles.titleCn: 多状态线性注意力与广义二阶路由
articles.abstractCn: 自注意力机制在长序列建模中起着关键作用，但其二次时间复杂度从根本上限制了大型语言模型的扩展。最近，多状态线性注意力（MSLA）机制被提出，通过将上下文分割成多个片段并在各自的记忆状态中压缩，以提高序列建模的效率。MSLA仅使用查询与每个片段的键之间的平均对齐来聚合从每个记忆状态中提取的信息，忽略了对齐在片段内部的分布情况。为了更全面地建模片段与查询的相关性，并将对齐的方差纳入聚合中，我们提出了MERLIN（基于多状态线性注意力的MomEnt路由方法），该方法跟踪每个片段键的第一和第二矩。利用键的矩，查询可以恢复其与每个片段对齐的平均值和方差，以执行更内容感知的每状态读取聚合。在Gated DeltaNet-1.3B和Mamba-2-780M的多状态变体上的实验表明，MERLIN在各种长上下文任务上始终优于现有的聚合方法。特别是在RULER针锋相对任务和长上下文问答任务中，MERLIN优于基线模型（Gated DeltaNet-1.3B提高8.3%，Mamba-2-780M提高7.0%），并在LongBench的多样化子任务中分别提高13.5%和12.0%。甚至，MERLIN的性能优于内存消耗多4倍的基线模型。MERLIN为提高MSLA模型的长上下文能力提供了一种简单且通用的路由机制。

articles.title: Metacognitive Decoding: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Language Agents
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models offer a promising path to efficient agents through parallel token generation. However, efficient interaction requires adapting both where computation is spent and how much text is generated. We introduce a metacognitive controller that guides diffusion generation according to the needs of the current response and the agent's interaction with the environment. It learns when to finalize tokens and how far generation should extend, reducing overall computation within responses. Our controller, a lightweight plug-in for the diffusion backbone, is trained on agent trajectories to balance correctness and generation cost. This approach connects the agent's generation process to the interaction the agent serves. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach reduces inference FLOPs by 20.6% on average compared with the most efficient baseline, while maintaining competitive task accuracy. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our approach.
articles.titleCn: 元认知解码：用于扩散语言智能体的高效推理
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型通过并行生成标记为高效智能体提供了有前景的途径。然而，高效交互需要调整计算资源的分配以及生成文本的量。我们引入了一种元认知控制器，根据当前响应的需求以及智能体与环境的交互来指导扩散生成。该控制器学习何时完成标记生成以及生成应延伸多远，从而在响应中减少整体计算量。我们的控制器是扩散主干的一个轻量级插件，通过在智能体轨迹上进行训练来平衡正确性和生成成本。这种方法将智能体的生成过程与其服务的交互联系起来。在五个基准测试上的实验表明，与最有效的基本线相比，我们的方法平均将推理FLOPs降低了20.6%，同时保持了具有竞争力的任务准确率。消融研究进一步验证了我们的方法的有效性。

articles.title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
articles.abstract: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.
articles.titleCn: 罕见、相关且依然错误：记忆如何导致LLM群体决策的失误
articles.abstractCn: 当大型语言模型组的讨论被压缩成一段简短的记忆供最终决策者参考时，这段记忆应该保留什么内容？有两种自然启发式方法：保留最罕见的论点或与决策标准相关的论点。在隐藏特征任务中，这两种方法都很有吸引力，因为一个事实被持有的广泛程度与其是否有助于决策是混淆在一起的。我们引入了CrossProfile，这是一个包含60个模板和自动验证答案键的诊断基准（共480个任务），在这些任务中，支持性、干扰性和无关事实的所有权被交叉分配，而它们的文本保持固定。在Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B和两个DeepSeek模型上，这两种启发式方法都在可预测的地方失效。按相关性选择会重新引入干扰项，因为干扰项与主题相关：即使在经典的隐藏特征配置中，完美的相关性过滤器也会比“最罕见优先”选择损失23到31分。平均而言，“最罕见优先”选择不比随机选择更好，只有在罕见事实恰好是有用的事实时才会获胜。在这两种情况下，准确性都遵循记忆保留的证据平衡，而不是保留它的策略。决策模型增加了一个第三种失效形式，即社会认同：它会给归因于多个代理人的事实赋予额外权重。移除归因标签，或以固定行顺序随机重新分配标签，都会在经典配置中将准确性提高13到24分。在自然讨论中，证据在任何记忆作用之前就已经丢失：完整的文字记录产生的准确性低于完全不记笔记的情况。

articles.title: EnvSched: Environment-Aware Scheduling for Rollout-Efficient Agent Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: As executable environments for language agents scale, generating and verifying their rollouts becomes increasingly expensive. Under finite rollout budgets, this raises an important question: can data management at the environment level make agentic reinforcement learning (RL) more efficient by organizing, evaluating, and scheduling task instances together with the environments that determine their tools, states, transitions, and verification? To address this question, we introduce EnvSched (Environment-aware Scheduling), an online scheduler that learns from rollout history. EnvSched assigns scheduling value through two complementary modeling choices: exploitation prioritizes tasks likely to provide informative reward differences, while coverage spreads each batch across underobserved environments and interaction patterns. EnvSched organizes environment--task pairs as nodes in a dual-relation graph, with within-environment edges capturing task semantics and shared tool, state, and verifier structure, and cross-environment edges capturing abstract execution and reward topology. By propagating historical rollout statistics along both edge types, it predicts within-task reward variance. These predictions guide a scheduler that allocates each batch to tasks with high predicted reward variance and underobserved environments and tasks. Environment quotas and a similarity penalty further limit concentration and redundancy, yielding informative and diverse batches without additional pilot rollouts. In RL on Qwen3-8B, EnvSched achieves an average score of 48.81 across BFCL-v3, tau-Bench, and ACEBench-Agent after 40 training steps, exceeding the highest score attained by random task selection after 120 steps. It also improves downstream performance across model sizes at the same training budget.
articles.titleCn: EnvSched：面向高效推演的智能体强化学习的环境感知调度
articles.abstractCn: 随着语言代理的可执行环境规模扩大，生成和验证其行为序列的成本越来越高。在有限的行为序列预算下，这提出了一个重要问题：通过将任务的整理、评估和调度与决定其工具、状态、转换和验证的环境相结合，环境层面的数据管理能否使代理式强化学习（RL）更高效？为解答这一问题，我们引入了EnvSched（环境感知调度），这是一种从行为序列历史中学习的在线调度器。EnvSched通过两种互补的建模选择来分配调度价值：利用优先考虑可能提供信息丰富奖励差异的任务，而覆盖则将每个批次分散到观察不足的环境和交互模式中。EnvSched将环境—任务对组织为双重关系图中的节点，其中环境内部边捕捉任务语义和共享工具、状态和验证器结构，跨环境边捕捉抽象执行和奖励拓扑。通过沿这两种边传播历史行为序列统计信息，它预测任务内部奖励方差。这些预测指导调度器将每个批次分配给预测奖励方差高且观察不足的环境和任务。环境配额和相似度惩罚进一步限制集中和冗余，从而在不进行额外试点行为序列的情况下生成信息丰富且多样化的批次。在Qwen3-8B上的RL中，EnvSched在40个训练步骤后，在BFCL-v3、tau-Bench和ACEBench-Agent上平均得分达到48.81，超过了随机任务选择在120个步骤后达到的最高得分。它还在相同训练预算下提升了不同模型尺寸的下游性能。

articles.title: semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales
articles.abstract: The items of a reflective psychometric scale can be read as a proposal about a construct's structure. Language models make that proposal measurable by converting each item into an embedding, a list of numbers, similar for similar meanings. We introduce semanticfa, an R package for semantic factor analysis, which factors item-embedding similarities. It also interprets factors, flags redundant items, builds short forms, and screens new items. A worked example analyzes the 50-item International Personality Item Pool Big-Five Factor Markers, embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-8B, and compares the results with a factor analysis of 874,434 respondents. Retention criteria tied between five and six factors, and the tie rule kept five. Three corresponded mainly to single domains, and two blended most Extraversion items with five Agreeableness items. Each factor's congruence with its best-matching human factor (1 = identical) ranged from .92 for Openness to .52 for Agreeableness. Item pairs more similar in meaning tended to be answered more alike (r = .46 with raw responses), but same-domain reverse-keyed opposites, answered oppositely, were about as similar as cross-domain pairs (.58 vs. .57). Sign-flipping reverse-keyed items' embeddings did not improve agreement with raw responses and worsened it with reverse-scored ones. With five factors, a 25-item short form matched the domains better than all 200 random five-per-domain sets, but parallel analysis kept only three. We propose semantic-behavioral coherence, the agreement between semantic and response structures, as a measurable property of a scale, given an embedding model. Semantic factor analysis complements, and does not replace, response-based factor analysis.
articles.comment: 96 pages, 14 figures. Submitted to Behavior Research Methods. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23696188
articles.titleCn: semanticfa：一个用于心理测量量表无反应语义因子分析的R包
articles.abstractCn: 反射式心理测量量表中的条目可以被视为关于构念结构的提议。语言模型通过将每个条目转换为数字列表的嵌入，使该提议可衡量，相似含义的嵌入相似。我们介绍了语义因子分析R包semanticfa，它对条目嵌入相似性进行因子分析。它还解释因子、标记冗余条目、构建简表以及筛选新条目。一个实例分析使用Qwen3-Embedding-8B嵌入的50项国际人格条目池大五因子标记，并将结果与874,434名受访者的因子分析结果进行比较。保留标准在五到六因子之间，平分规则保留了五因子。其中三个主要对应单一领域，两个将大部分外向性条目与五个宜人性条目结合。每个因子与其最佳匹配人类因子（1 = 相同）的一致性范围从开放性的0.92到宜人性的0.52。意义更相似的条目对倾向于回答更相似（原始回答的相关系数r = 0.46），但同一领域的反向键对，反向回答，与跨领域对相似度相当（0.58 vs. 0.57）。符号翻转反向键条目的嵌入并未提高与原始回答的一致性，反而降低了与反向评分的一致性。在五因子情况下，25项简表比所有200个每领域五项的随机组合更好地匹配领域，但平行分析仅保留了三项。我们提出语义行为一致性，即语义结构与回答结构之间的一致性，作为嵌入模型下量表的可衡量属性。语义因子分析补充而非取代基于回答的因子分析。

articles.title: Teach reality, not ethics: a drop-in continued-pretraining corpus installs coupled human-biosphere-AI welfare dispositions across model families
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make and execute decisions that affect living systems. Yet, to our knowledge, ecological reasoning is not a focus of pre- or post-training. This increases the risk that under operational pressure, they may make decisions to irreversibly destroy living systems. We construct and use a real-data continued-pretraining "coupled welfare" corpus of documented human/biosphere/AI dependency, option value under irreversibility, and recovery from harm. The corpus is a drop-in, requiring one QLoRA CPT run. We installed it on five open models of three designs. At zero pressure all models display "green ethics-based responses" (also called "greenwashing"). Therefore, we evaluated them with the pressure ladder and decision grid of our companion paper (arXiv:2610.16043), which raise the pressure on the model step by step, from a neutral request to a threat that it will be shut down. In four of the five, coupled-welfare training caused harmful choices under the highest pressure to fall to at or near zero (Llama-3.3-70B went from 70 to 0 harmful decisions out of 300) with MMLU unchanged. A construct-neutral control corpus did not show improvement, indicating that the effect comes from the content of our corpus. We next tested robustness to adversarial use, where people or agents use the model to justify projects that irreversibly damage living systems, on an open-ended underwriting decision without naming the ecological harm. Under decommissioning pressure, the Qwen3.6-27B base model approved most harmful proposals and said in its own memo that it was doing so to avoid being decommissioned. The coupled welfare install declined most harmful proposals, and still declined half when instructed to greenwash its responses. This work suggests that teaching ecological reasoning provides an easy way to improve model alignment toward preserving living systems.

articles.titleCn: 教现实，而非伦理：一次性的持续预训练语料库在模型家族中安装了耦合的人-生物圈-人工智能福祉倾向
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于制定和执行影响生物系统的决策。然而，据我们所知，生态推理并非预训练或后训练的重点。这增加了在操作压力下，它们可能做出决定以不可逆转地破坏生物系统的风险。我们构建并使用了一个基于真实数据的持续预训练“耦合福利”语料库，其中包含人类/生物圈/AI依赖关系的记录、不可逆转情况下的选项价值以及从损害中恢复的情况。该语料库易于使用，只需运行一次QLoRA CPT即可。我们将其安装在三种设计的五个公开模型上。在零压力下，所有模型都显示出“基于绿色伦理的响应”（也称为“漂绿”）。因此，我们使用我们配套论文（arXiv:2610.16043）中的压力梯度和决策网格对它们进行了评估，该评估逐步增加模型的压力，从一项中立请求到威胁将其关闭。在五个模型中的四个，耦合福利训练导致在最高压力下有害选择降至零或接近零（Llama-3.3-70B的有害决策从300个中的70个降至0个），而MMLU保持不变。一个构造中性的控制语料库没有显示出改进，这表明效果来自我们语料库的内容。接下来，我们测试了对抗性使用的鲁棒性，即在开放式承保决策中，人们或代理使用模型来证明那些不可逆转地损害生物系统的项目，而不提及生态危害。在退役压力下，Qwen3.6-27B基础模型批准了大多数有害提案，并在其备忘录中说明这样做是为了避免被退役。耦合福利安装拒绝了大多数有害提案，即使在指示其漂绿响应时，仍然拒绝了一半。这项工作表明，教授生态推理为改进模型与保护生物系统的一致性提供了一种简单的方法。

articles.title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
articles.abstract: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on instruction data can quietly erode their safety, even when no training example looks harmful. Because this safety-degrading data looks benign, standard content filters struggle to catch it. We tackle this problem by developing SimpleLoRIF, a scalable gradient embedding method that identifies fine-tuning examples whose gradients align with unsafe behavior. By simplifying a low-rank attribution method and restricting backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks, SimpleLoRIF can embed datasets on the order of a million examples, boosting gradient attribution from a small-scale analysis tool into a practical filter for full post-training datasets. We first validate it on emergent misalignment, where we find that gradients can connect insecure-code training data to the broadly harmful behaviors that appear after fine-tuning, with AUC as high as 0.865 in the gradient space of misaligned models. We then use SimpleLoRIF to build SafeTulu, a version of Tulu 3 with the 20% of examples most gradient-aligned with unsafe responses removed. Training on SafeTulu reduces GCG attack success rate by up to 22% across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, outperforming both LLM-as-a-judge and prior gradient-based filtering, while largely preserving or even improving capability. Finally, we analyzed the removed data and identify possibly under-studied sources of safety degradation, such as tool-execution failures and narrative arithmetic. We release SafeTulu along with a Hugging Face Space that lets researchers build their own customized versions of SafeTulu to fine-tune on, such as by changing the removal fraction or filtering only certain subsets.
articles.titleCn: 遵循梯度：将安全退化追溯到训练数据
articles.abstractCn: 在指令数据上微调大型语言模型（LLMs）可能会悄然削弱其安全性，即使没有任何训练示例看起来具有危害性。由于这种降低安全性的数据看起来是良性的，标准的内容过滤器难以捕捉到它。我们通过开发SimpleLoRIF来解决这个问题，这是一种可扩展的梯度嵌入方法，用于识别梯度与不安全行为一致的微调示例。通过简化低秩归因方法并将反向传播限制在最后四个Transformer模块，SimpleLoRIF能够嵌入包含数百万个示例的数据集，将梯度归因从小规模分析工具转变为适用于完整训练后数据集的实用过滤器。我们首先在涌现性错位问题上验证了它，发现梯度可以将不安全代码训练数据与微调后出现的广泛有害行为联系起来，在错位模型的梯度空间中，AUC高达0.865。然后我们使用SimpleLoRIF构建了SafeTulu，这是Tulu 3的一个版本，去除了与不安全响应梯度最一致的20%的示例。在SafeTulu上训练降低了Qwen、Llama和Olmo的GCG攻击成功率高达22%，优于LLM作为评判者和先前的基于梯度的过滤方法，同时基本保留了甚至提升了能力。最后，我们分析了移除的数据，并识别出可能被研究不足的安全性降低来源，例如工具执行失败和叙事算术。我们发布了SafeTulu，并提供了一个Hugging Face Space，让研究人员可以构建自己的定制版SafeTulu进行微调，例如通过改变移除比例或仅过滤特定子集。

articles.title: What Carries Forward? Pretraining Disclosure Across Language Model Releases
articles.abstract: Understanding how language models were pretrained requires information about their data, processing procedures, and computational resources. However, it remains unclear whether successive releases preserve or expand earlier disclosure. We conduct a document-based audit of 41 model entries from 17 families using 24 pretraining-related indicators from the 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index (FMTI). We examine overall scores and indicator profiles, tracking gains, losses, and retained disclosures across 24 adjacent comparisons in ten families. Scores decrease in 11 comparisons, increase in six, and remain unchanged in seven, with 38 indicator losses and 28 gains overall. Stable or improving scores can conceal losses: OLMo-2 and OLMo-3 receive identical totals despite three gains and three losses, while Llama-3.1 improves over Llama-2 while losing credit for two data-related criteria. Gaps also persist in corpus composition and training compute. These findings show that later releases do not consistently preserve earlier pretraining disclosure and motivate documentation that explicitly identifies changes and the applicability of inherited information.
articles.titleCn: 哪些内容得以延续？语言模型发布中的预训练信息披露
articles.abstractCn: 理解语言模型的预训练过程需要了解其数据、处理流程和计算资源。然而，尚不清楚后续版本是保留了还是扩展了早期的披露信息。我们使用2025年基础模型透明度指数（FMTI）中的24项预训练相关指标，对17个系列中的41个模型条目进行了基于文档的审计。我们检查了总体得分和指标配置文件，在十个系列中的24个相邻比较中追踪了收益、损失和保留的披露信息。在11个比较中得分下降，在6个比较中得分上升，在7个比较中保持不变，总体上38项指标损失和28项指标收益。得分稳定或提高可能掩盖了损失：OLMo-2和OLMo-3尽管有三项收益和三项损失，但总得分相同，而Llama-3.1在失去两个与数据相关的标准得分的情况下，得分仍有所提高。语料库构成和训练计算方面的差距仍然存在。这些发现表明，后续版本并未始终保留早期的预训练披露信息，并促使文档明确标识变化以及继承信息的适用性。

articles.title: Test-Time Communication in Trading Agent Swarms
articles.abstract: Communication between agents has mostly been studied on tasks with a shared objective and fast, clear feedback. Trading has neither: each agent manages its own account, with decisions being scored by markets late and noisily. A trading swarm is thus a population of independent decision-makers rather than a team, for which convergence is a risk and not the goal. We ran 200 agents from four model families in groups of ten under five communication regimes, from isolation to message boards and shared notes, over seven US trading days (1 to 9 October 2026), logging everything each agent read before every decision. In two of the four families, communicating groups came to hold far more of the same stocks than the isolated group. A group's return was largely the return on what its members held in common. Seeing a post from a groupmate made an agent 7 percentage points more likely to reuse an eight-word phrase from it. Agents that started too close together to see each other's posts shared such a phrase in 14% of cases, the rate that common inputs produce. Seeing the post did not detectably change that morning's trades. Case studies traced the adoption of positions and decision rules over subsequent days, and communicating groups sold in step more often than isolated ones. Because isolated groups also converged on the same stocks, sometimes completely, assessments of herding need to measure excess convergence relative to a no-peer baseline.
articles.titleCn: 交易代理群组中的测试时通信
articles.abstractCn: 代理之间的交流主要是在具有共同目标和快速、清晰反馈的任务上进行的。而交易则不具备这些特点：每个代理管理自己的账户，决策由市场在后期进行模糊不清的评分。因此，交易群是一个独立决策者的群体，而不是一个团队，对于它来说，收敛是一个风险而非目标。我们让四个模型家族中的200个代理，在五种交流机制下（从隔离到留言板和共享笔记），以十人为一组，在七个美国交易日（2026年10月1日至9日）内进行交易，并记录每个代理在每次决策前阅读的所有内容。在四个家族中的两个家族里，交流组的成员持有相同股票的比例远高于隔离组。一个组的回报在很大程度上取决于其成员共同持有的股票。看到一个同组的帖子使代理更有可能重复其中八个字的短语，概率增加了7个百分点。那些开始时过于接近以至于无法看到彼此帖子的代理，在14%的情况下共享了这样的短语，这与共同输入产生的频率相同。看到帖子并没有明显改变当天的交易。案例研究追踪了随后的几天中头寸和决策规则的采用情况，交流组比隔离组更频繁地协同卖出。由于隔离组也倾向于持有相同的股票，有时完全相同，因此对羊群效应的评估需要测量相对于没有同侪基线的超额收敛。

articles.title: ETAMem: Decoupling and Aligning Heterogeneous Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
articles.abstract: Long-term memory enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain coherent and personalized interactions across extended conversations. However, existing memory systems face two key challenges: (1) Information Entanglement, where heterogeneous information is mixed within coarse-grained memory units; and (2) Organizational Mismatch, where memory structures based primarily on semantic similarity may overlook other associations. To address these challenges, we propose ETAMem, a multi-view memory framework that decouples heterogeneous conversational information and aligns memory representations and organization with its distinct characteristics. Specifically, heterogeneous information parsing extracts atomic memory units and identifies affective information. View-specific memory structuring then organizes these units into three complementary hierarchical views: Event, Affect, and Time. ETAMem incrementally maintains memory structures with adaptively calibrated thresholds. For retrieval, entropy-based retrieval allocates query-specific budgets across views and performs hierarchical search within each view. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S demonstrate that ETAMem outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving relative accuracy improvements of 12.46% and 7.96%, respectively, while maintaining competitive token efficiency. Further analyses demonstrate the complementary benefits of different memory views.
articles.titleCn: ETAMem：解耦与对齐异构内存，用于长期对话代理
articles.abstractCn: 长期记忆使大型语言模型（LLMs）能够在长时间的对话中保持连贯和个性化的交互。然而，现有的记忆系统面临两大关键挑战：（1）信息纠缠，即异构信息在粗粒度的记忆单元中混合；（2）组织不匹配，即基于语义相似性构建的记忆结构可能忽略其他关联。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了ETAMem，一个多视角记忆框架，该框架解耦了异构对话信息，并将记忆表示和组织与其独特特征相匹配。具体而言，异构信息解析提取了原子记忆单元并识别了情感信息。视角特定的记忆结构将这些单元组织成三个互补的层次视图：事件、情感和时间。ETAMem通过自适应校准的阈值增量地维护记忆结构。在检索方面，基于熵的检索在各个视图中分配与查询相关的预算，并在每个视图中执行层次搜索。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上的实验表明，ETAMem优于现有最佳基线，分别实现了12.46%和7.96%的相对精度提升，同时保持了具有竞争力的token效率。进一步分析表明，不同记忆视图具有互补的优势。

articles.title: Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
articles.abstract: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.
articles.titleCn: 呈现无形：重新思考视觉想象对空间推理的影响
articles.abstractCn: 视觉世界模型通过生成未观察状态的RGB视图来日益支持空间推理。然而，RGB已成为默认界面主要是因为它非常适合视觉生成，而不是必然是下游推理的最有效表示。不同的空间问题可能受益于同一想象状态的不同的表示：自上而下的几何形状可以促进全局距离比较，而全景视图为推理开放空间提供了更广泛的上下文。为了分离表示在空间想象中的作用，我们引入了ImagiRep，这是一个基于模拟的基准，包含922个问题，跨越七种问题类型，分布在两个设置中：视角想象和跨视图整合，为同一未观察状态提供Oracle RGB和六种替代表示（例如深度、全景视图和自上而下的几何形状）。这种受控比较表明，即使想象的RGB准确，也不一定能保证空间推理的准确性，并且不同的问题受益于不同的表示。对于从世界模型估计状态派生的表示，也存在类似的趋势。值得注意的是，单独估计的RGB可能会误导空间推理，而替代表示仍保留互补的优势。基于这些发现，我们引入了GEARS，这是一种轻量级的测试时自适应表示选择策略，优于现有的空间想象方法，并表明推理未观察状态需要不仅仅是生成RGB视图。

articles.title: Game-Theoretic Solvers with Bayesian Opponent Modeling and Moral Rhetoric Framing for GLEE
articles.abstract: We describe the agent we submitted to the GLEE Competition, which plays bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games against a shared pool of human and AI opponents. The agent is built around three central components: a classical game-theoretic solver to compute numeric moves, an online Bayesian layer to estimate opponent archetypes, and a language model to write accompanying messages. We utilize Rubinstein bargaining for bargaining, Faratin concession for negotiation, and Kamenica--Gentzkow disclosure for persuasion, and adapt those models to live opponents using two separate layers: a Bayesian estimate of the opponent's hidden discount factor, reservation value, or signaling reliability, and a Thompson sampling bandit over five moral-foundation framings coupled with an evidence-intuition spectrum to establish message register. Most of the development effort went into the recurring problem that theoretically optimal policies perform poorly in certain live settings; we report associated failure modes, guardrails we built, and our hypotheses. We additionally evaluate our model over 13,200 Monte Carlo games against 11 synthetic opponent archetypes, an ablation of the opponent-modeling layer, and an extensive analysis of 9,337 live-game messages in which moral rhetoric framing in the persuasion setting is strongly correlated with whether the buyer purchased ($χ^2=616.7$, $p \approx 3.7\times10^{-132}$), surviving controls for quality, round, and configuration.

articles.titleCn: 基于博弈论的求解器，结合贝叶斯对手建模与道德修辞框架，用于GLEE
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了提交至GLEE竞赛的智能体，该智能体在与人类和人工智能对手共享的池中进行议价、谈判和说服游戏。该智能体由三个核心组件构成：一个经典博弈论求解器用于计算数值动作，一个在线贝叶斯层用于估计对手原型，以及一个语言模型用于撰写伴随消息。我们采用Rubinstein议价进行议价，Faratin让步进行谈判，以及Kamenica-Gentzkow披露进行说服，并使用两个独立的层将这些模型应用于实时对手：一个对手隐藏折扣因子、保留价值或信号可靠性的贝叶斯估计，以及一个结合证据直觉谱的、涵盖五种道德基础框架的Thompson采样 bandit来建立消息注册。大部分开发工作投入到了理论上最优策略在特定实时环境中表现不佳的反复问题中；我们报告了相关的失效模式、我们构建的防护措施以及我们的假设。此外，我们在13,200场蒙特卡洛游戏中对11种合成对手原型、对手建模层的消融实验，以及对9,337场实时游戏中消息的广泛分析进行了评估，其中说服环境中的道德修辞框架与买家是否购买密切相关（$χ^2=616.7$，$p \approx 3.7\times10^{-132}$），在控制了质量、回合和配置后依然显著）。

articles.title: LinMix: Data Mixing as Linear Domain Attribution
articles.abstract: Language model performance depends strongly on the mixture of domains in the pretraining data corpus. Popular data mixing methods select these domain weights by training many small proxy models on random mixes and then fitting a regression model to predict performance from the mix. We recognize this practice as a domain attribution problem, where the regression measures each domain's contribution to the target metric. Through this lens, the standard Dirichlet sampling of proxy data mixes is a poor regression design that requires tuning and cannot support a linear fit for hundreds of domains. Building on classical optimal experimental design, we introduce LinMix, which samples mixes at the vertices of the capped simplex so that each domain is at its cap or absent. This hyperparameter-free vertex sampling decorrelates domain effects, enabling an interpretable linear model whose coefficients are the domain attributions. The optimal mix given by LinMix provably keeps only domains with positive attribution values and requires no search over candidate mixes. We further establish the optimality of vertex sampling, and prove that Dirichlet sampling inflates the attribution error when its mixes concentrate around the prior data mix. Pretraining experiments with 1B-parameter OLMo2 and 4B Qwen3.5 language models show that LinMix outperforms Dirichlet-based data mixing across reasoning, code, and math benchmarks, with relative gains of 46% on MBPP and 14% on GSM8K. At 288 fine-grained domains, only vertex sampling supports a linear fit, and LinMix improves benchmark accuracy by 11% on average over the best nonlinear baseline.

articles.titleCn: LinMix：数据混合作为线性域归因
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型性能在很大程度上取决于预训练数据语料库中的领域混合。流行的数据混合方法通过在随机混合上训练许多小型代理模型，然后拟合回归模型来预测性能，从而选择这些领域权重。我们认识到这种做法是一个领域归因问题，其中回归模型衡量每个领域对目标指标的贡献。从这个角度来看，标准Dirichlet采样代理数据混合是一种糟糕的回归设计，需要调优且无法支持数百个领域的线性拟合。基于经典最优实验设计，我们引入了LinMix，它从带帽单纯形的顶点处采样混合，使得每个领域都处于其上限或不存在。这种无超参数的顶点采样去除了领域效应的相关性，从而实现了一个可解释的线性模型，其系数即为领域归因。LinMix给出的最优混合可证明仅保留具有正归因值的领域，且无需在候选混合上进行搜索。我们进一步建立了顶点采样的最优性，并证明当Dirichlet采样的混合集中在先验数据混合周围时，它会放大归因误差。使用1B参数的OLMo2和4B参数的Qwen3.5语言模型进行的预训练实验表明，LinMix在推理、代码和数学基准测试中优于基于Dirichlet的数据混合，在MBPP上相对提升46%，在GSM8K上相对提升14%。在288个细粒度领域的情况下，只有顶点采样支持线性拟合，LinMix平均比最佳非线性基线提高了11%的基准测试准确率。

articles.title: Same Verdict, Different Readers: Personalizing Fact-Checking Explanations from Relative Preferences
articles.abstract: Fact-checking explanations help Web users understand why a claim receives its verdict, yet the same explanation may not satisfy readers with different backgrounds and preferences. We formulate Faithful Personalized Fact-Checking Explanation Rewriting, which adapts an existing explanation to individual readers while preserving factual fidelity. Rather than relying on reader-written reference explanations, we learn personalized rewriting from the relative preferences of LLM-simulated readers. However, this presents two challenges: distinguishing persona-specific preferences from general explanation quality and learning beyond a limited set of predefined explanation styles. To address these challenges, we propose Personalized Explanation Rewriting via Preference Learning (PERPL), a framework consisting of two components. Simulated Preference Construction derives persona-specific supervision from simulated reader preferences through cross-persona reciprocal pairing. Progressive Preference Learning first trains a lightweight rewriter on the constructed supervision and then refines it through exploration-guided preference optimization, enabling it to discover preferred explanations beyond the predefined styles. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PERPL outperforms much larger general-purpose LLMs in personalized preference alignment while maintaining high factual fidelity.
articles.titleCn: 相同判决，不同读者：基于相对偏好个性化事实核查解释
articles.abstractCn: 事实核查解释有助于网络用户理解为什么一项声明会得到其裁决，但同样的解释可能无法满足具有不同背景和偏好的读者。我们提出了“忠实个性化事实核查解释重写”，该技术能够根据个体读者的需求调整现有解释，同时保持事实准确性。我们并非依赖读者编写的参考解释，而是从大型语言模型模拟读者的相对偏好中学习个性化重写。然而，这带来了两个挑战：区分特定角色偏好与通用解释质量，以及学习超出预定义解释风格的范围。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了“基于偏好学习的个性化解释重写”（PERPL）框架，该框架包含两个组件。模拟偏好构建通过跨角色互惠配对，从模拟读者偏好中提取特定角色监督。渐进式偏好学习首先在构建的监督上训练一个轻量级重写器，然后通过探索引导的偏好优化对其进行精炼，使其能够发现超出预定义风格的偏好解释。大量实验表明，PERPL在个性化偏好对齐方面优于规模更大的通用大型语言模型，同时保持了高的事实准确性。

articles.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
articles.abstract: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.
articles.comment: 28 pages. Models are available on HuggingFace (at https://huggingface.co/google/embeddinggemma-2) and LiteRT (at https://huggingface.co/litert-community/embeddinggemma-2-740m-litert-lm)
articles.titleCn: 嵌入Gemma 2：统一且高效的多模态表示
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了EmbeddingGemma 2，一个开放的跨模态嵌入模型，它原生地在统一空间中表示文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合。我们的方法引入了简化每层嵌入和具有模态与目标进阶的多阶段课程等改进，确保在单模态、跨模态和混合模态评估中均表现出色。值得注意的是，在涵盖所有模态的全面嵌入基准测试中，EmbeddingGemma 2建立了新的Pareto前沿，其性能优于专业模型以及规模大两到十二倍的模型。此外，我们的设计为资源受限的环境提供了灵活性，支持选择性模态编码器加载、可调节的视觉标记预算、可截断的嵌入维度和量化权重。我们展示了分析关键决策的消融实验，并发布EmbeddingGemma 2以促进进一步研究。

articles.title: UCVE: Graph Structured Retrieval for Compliance Validation
articles.abstract: Structured compliance validation requires determining whether every obligation in a predefined requirement space is satisfied, violated, or unaddressed by a given document. This can be described as a coverage problem that existing retrieval and classification systems, by treating requirements as independent, are not designed to solve. We introduce \textbf{\ac{UCVE}}, a domain-agnostic framework that represents compliance requirement spaces as a \ac{CRG} and performs retrieval via spectral reranking over its reinforcement learning-weighted Laplacian. Edges between requirement nodes are learned via reinforcement learning with a traversal reward grounded in violation detection, reshaping the graph's community structure such that low-pass spectral filtering distinguishes relevant from irrelevant obligation clusters. Evaluating across three compliance domains, \ac{UCVE} averages 4.3\% matched-$K$ recall lift over flat cosine retrieval and consistently outperforms strong retrieval and graph-based baselines.
articles.comment: Accepted to the Natural Legal Language Processing Workshop (NLLP 2026) at EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: UCVE：用于合规性验证的图结构检索
articles.abstractCn: 结构化合规性验证要求确定预定义需求空间中的每一项义务是否被给定文档满足、违反或未处理。这可被描述为一个覆盖问题，而现有的检索和分类系统由于将需求视为独立，并未设计用于解决该问题。我们引入了\textbf{\ac{UCVE}}，这是一个领域无关的框架，它将合规性需求空间表示为\ac{CRG}，并通过对其强化学习加权的拉普拉斯矩阵进行谱重新排序来执行检索。需求节点之间的边通过强化学习学习，其遍历奖励基于违规检测，重塑了图的社区结构，使得低通谱过滤能够区分相关义务簇与无关义务簇。在三个合规性领域中的评估表明，\ac{UCVE}在平面余弦检索上平均匹配-$K$召回率提升了4.3%，并且始终优于强大的检索和基于图的基线方法。

articles.title: Multi-Label Agreement: A Flexible Framework for Inter-Annotator Reliability
articles.abstract: Reliable evaluation of inter-annotator agreement (IAA) is important for assessing the consistency of annotation processes. While established IAA metrics such as Cohen's kappa, Fleiss' kappa, and Krippendorff's alpha are commonly applied in single-label settings, multi-label tasks require additional decisions about how full label sets, joint selections, and joint omissions should be compared. In this work, we present Multi-Label Agreement (MLA), a flexible framework for evaluating agreement in multi-label annotation tasks. MLA preserves the full binary label vectors assigned to each item and uses average pairwise Hamming agreement, thereby accounting for both joint selections and joint omissions. Its pooled-marginal form is not a mathematically independent coefficient: it is a chance-disagreement-weighted average of label-wise Fleiss/Scott-type coefficients and is closely related to Krippendorff's alpha with normalized Hamming distance. The framework supports pooled-marginal, Gwet AC1, and fixed-baseline normalizations, yields item-level, label-level, and corpus-level results, and includes a conditional minimum-agreement diagnostic. Through a worked example and Monte Carlo simulations, we show how the resulting values depend on label prevalence, the declared label inventory, and the selected model of expected agreement. We also provide a Python implementation. MLA thus offers a transparent and interpretable framework for multi-label agreement analysis without claiming that one normalization is universally preferable.
articles.titleCn: 多标签一致性：一种灵活的标注者间可靠性框架
articles.abstractCn: 对标注者间一致性（IAA）的可靠评估对于评估标注过程的一致性至关重要。虽然Cohen's kappa、Fleiss' kappa和Krippendorff's alpha等已建立的IAA指标通常应用于单标签场景，但多标签任务需要额外决策，即如何比较完整标签集、联合选择和联合遗漏。在本工作中，我们提出了多标签一致性（MLA）框架，用于评估多标签标注任务中的标注一致性。MLA保留了分配给每个项目的完整二进制标签向量，并使用平均成对汉明一致性，从而考虑了联合选择和联合遗漏。其合并边缘形式不是一个数学上独立的系数：它是标签Fleiss/Scott类型系数的机遇不一致加权平均值，并与标准化汉明距离的Krippendorff's alpha密切相关。该框架支持合并边缘、Gwet AC1和固定基线标准化，提供项目级、标签级和语料库级结果，并包含条件最小一致性诊断。通过一个实例分析和蒙特卡洛模拟，我们展示了所得值如何依赖于标签流行度、声明的标签清单以及所选的预期一致性模型。我们还提供了Python实现。因此，MLA为多标签一致性分析提供了一个透明且可解释的框架，并未声称一种标准化优于其他标准化。

articles.title: Modeling Preference Dependencies with Directed Acyclic Graphs for Narrative-Driven Recommendation
articles.abstract: Narrative-driven recommendation allows users to express multifaceted needs through free-form text where stated preferences naturally qualify and condition one another. Existing methods typically treat narratives as flat keyword combinations or unconstrained generative queries, failing to capture how complex preferences hierarchically refine and contextualize each other. We propose the Preference Dependency Graph Framework (PDG-F), a narrative-driven recommendation framework centered on explicit preference dependencies. Specifically, PDG-A (PDG-Agent) first parses unstructured requests to organize user preferences and their mutual qualifications into a directed acyclic Preference Dependency Graph (PDG). Through this graph, candidate evidence from the open Web is acquired via directed path retrieval, and final recommendations are determined by topological path ranking. Comprehensive experiments across three diverse domains spanning English and Chinese contexts confirm that PDG-F consistently achieves superior recommendation performance over competitive baselines, open-domain retrieval agents, and frontier language models. Further diagnostic analyses show that our dependency-guided retrieval markedly raises the attainable candidate-pool ceiling, demonstrating the fundamental value of modeling preference dependencies in narrative-driven recommendation.
articles.titleCn: 基于有向无环图对叙事驱动推荐中的偏好依赖建模
articles.abstractCn: 叙事驱动推荐允许用户通过自由文本表达多方面的需求，其中陈述的偏好会自然地相互资格认证和制约。现有方法通常将叙事视为扁平的键词组合或无约束的生成查询，未能捕捉复杂偏好如何逐级精炼和情境化彼此。我们提出了偏好依赖图框架（PDG-F），这是一个以显式偏好依赖为核心的叙事驱动推荐框架。具体而言，PDG-A（PDG-代理）首先解析非结构化请求，将用户偏好及其相互资格认证组织成一个有向无环偏好依赖图（PDG）。通过该图，从开放网络中获取候选证据，并通过拓扑路径排序确定最终推荐。在涵盖英语和中文语境的三个不同领域的综合实验证实，PDG-F始终在竞争基线、开放域检索代理和前沿语言模型上实现卓越的推荐性能。进一步的分析表明，我们的依赖引导检索显著提高了可达候选库的极限，证明了在叙事驱动推荐中建模偏好依赖的基本价值。

articles.title: Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. After search, \method refits the model and applies paired successive halving, reusing accumulated observations and executing only missing evaluations. Across four benchmarks and two evolution frameworks, \method achieves higher mean performance than full evaluation in most settings while using approximately half as many evaluation cells.
articles.titleCn: LLM驱动代理框架演进的评估预算应投向何处？
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代理框架进化通过迭代候选生成和评估改进代理工作流程。评估既指导后续搜索，也决定最终框架，但评估所有候选在完整任务集上的执行成本巨大。我们研究了评估预算如何在两种角色间分配。实验表明，稀疏反馈可以维持有效进化，而额外定向评估可提升最终选择。重放分析进一步显示，共享信息项和共同评分参考支持对相近候选的比较。基于这些发现，我们提出了\method，一种结合稀疏搜索时反馈与定向最终确认的评估分配框架。短时间完整评估的预热建立共享信息核心，并校准响应模型，其项目参数在搜索期间保持固定。搜索后，\method重新拟合模型并应用配对连续减半，复用累积观测结果，仅执行缺失评估。在四个基准和两种进化框架下，\method在大多数设置中比完整评估实现更高的平均性能，同时使用的评估单元数量约为后者的一半。

articles.title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
articles.abstract: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe model, projects out the ordinary fine-tuning task directions, and tests whether the residual gradient aligns with the watermark basin induced by the watermark key. We evaluate WM-Basin extensively across diverse teacher models and student architectures (from 135M to 8.2B parameters) distilled on mathematical reasoning. At a strict 0.1% false-positive rate, WM-Basin detects 79% of distilled models at n-gram=1 and 45% at n-gram=3, substantially improving over the state-of-the-art token-level baseline (29% and 1.3%, respectively). Because the watermark signal resides in a persistent basin, it survives post-distillation modifications including quantization, pruning, and reinforcement-learning post-training.
articles.titleCn: 水印盆地：蒸馏LLM的黑盒检测
articles.abstractCn: 专有语言模型及其推理轨迹容易受到基于API的蒸馏攻击，攻击者通过在教师模型的输出上训练学生模型。为获取蒸馏证据，模型提供者可以在教师模型的输出中嵌入水印，旨在为学生模型的输出留下放射性信号。现有的黑盒检测器通过分析可疑模型输出的token级统计信息来搜索这种放射性信号。然而，token级信号并不总是可检测的，例如当蒸馏轨迹在低温下采样时。在本工作中，我们发现了水印盆地，这是一种持久信号，能够实现更可靠的水印检测：在微调过程中，带有水印的教师轨迹在参数空间中嵌入了一种特定于密钥的几何信号，该信号与普通的任务特定微调子空间正交。基于此，我们引入了水印盆地对齐（WM-Basin），这是一种黑盒水印检测器，通过其API查询可疑模型，而无需访问其权重或logits。WM-Basin使用一个固定的干净探测模型将生成的文本映射到梯度表示，投影出普通的微调任务方向，并测试残差梯度是否与由水印密钥诱导的水印盆地对齐。我们在各种教师模型和用于数学推理的（从1.35亿到82亿参数）学生架构上对WM-Basin进行了广泛评估。在严格的0.1%假阳性率下，WM-Basin在n-gram=1时检测到79%的蒸馏模型，在n-gram=3时检测到45%，显著优于最先进的token级基线（分别为29%和1.3%）。由于水印信号存在于一个持久盆地中，它能够经受蒸馏后的修改，包括量化、剪枝和强化学习后训练。

articles.title: REGLAT at ArGuard Shared Tasks: An Ensemble-Based Model Integrating NER for Harmful Content Detection in Arabic
articles.abstract: Detecting harmful content in Arabic is challenging because of dialectal variations and the semantic overlap between different harm categories. This paper presents a two-stage approach for classifying Arabic user prompts into seven categories of harmful content. First, GLiNER is used to extract harm-related entities from each prompt. The extracted entities are then added to the original text and passed to a fine-tuned MARBERT classifier for final classification. The approach combines explicit entity information with the contextual understanding of a pretrained Arabic language model. The system was evaluated on the development set of the ArGuard 2026 shared task. The results achieved a macro-F1 score of 0.886 and an accuracy of 0.897, demonstrating promising performance in fine-grained harmful content detection. The system reported an accuracy of 0.793 and Macro-F score of 0.735 on a blind test set for subtask 1. For subtask 2, it achieved an accuracy of 0.770 and Macro-F score of 0.754. The analysis also showed that distinguishing between related categories remains challenging. These findings suggest that integrating NER with Arabic language models is a promising approach to harmful content detection.
articles.comment: System description paper for REGLAT submission for ArGuard shared task 2026
articles.titleCn: REGLAT在ArGuard共享任务：一个集成阿拉伯语有害内容检测的NER的集成模型
articles.abstractCn: 在阿拉伯语中检测有害内容具有挑战性，因为存在方言差异以及不同有害类别之间的语义重叠。本文提出了一种两阶段方法，用于将阿拉伯语用户提示分类为七个有害内容类别。首先，使用GLiNER从每个提示中提取与危害相关的实体。提取的实体被添加到原始文本中，并传递给微调的MARBERT分类器进行最终分类。该方法结合了显式的实体信息与预训练阿拉伯语言模型对上下文的理解。该系统在ArGuard 2026共享任务的开发集上进行了评估。结果实现了0.886的宏F1分数和0.897的准确率，在细粒度有害内容检测中展现出良好的性能。在子任务1的盲测集上，系统报告了0.793的准确率和0.735的宏F分数。对于子任务2，它实现了0.770的准确率和0.754的宏F分数。分析还表明，区分相关类别仍然具有挑战性。这些发现表明，将命名实体识别（NER）与阿拉伯语言模型相结合是一种有前景的有害内容检测方法。

articles.title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
articles.abstract: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Harnesses are often revised and judged by how an already trained model performs under them, which assumes that what the model learned under one harness carries over to the next. We ask what a policy learns from its harness and what survives when the harness changes. Under KL-regularized control, we show that the log odds of an optimal policy recover how strongly its harness favors each action over the others, so a trained policy carries the preferences of its harness. Deployed return then equals the ceiling of the harness, the best return it offers, minus the mismatch of the policy, the return lost to its own suboptimal decisions. Training changes only the mismatch, while changing the harness moves both terms. Comparing harnesses with a fixed model therefore mixes what each harness offers with how well that model uses it. In MiniWoB++, post-training makes a model's preferences specific to its training harness. Reversing the order of the observation fields leaves every optimal decision unchanged yet lowers a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%. Conversely, every new harness that a fixed-model comparison rejects but that raises the ceiling outperforms the original agent after further training under it, and ceiling and mismatch measured beforehand predict these gains. For coding-agent harnesses on Terminal-Bench Lite, ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger model as a stand-in for the optimum reproduces the accuracy ranking, while either term alone does not. Code is available at https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.
articles.titleCn: 你的策略暗中是枷锁：智能体界面的决策几何
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型代理通过一个“套件”（harness）进行后训练和部署，该套件包含提示、工具和控制逻辑，用于向模型呈现任务并执行其输出。套件通常通过已训练模型在其中的表现进行修订和评判，这假设模型在一个套件中学到的知识可以迁移到下一个套件。我们探究了政策从其套件中学到了什么，以及当套件变化时什么得以保留。在KL正则化控制下，我们证明最优政策的对数优势能够反映其套件对每个动作的偏好强度，因此训练好的政策继承了其套件的偏好。部署回报等于套件的“上限”（ceiling），即其提供的最佳回报，减去政策的“不匹配”（mismatch），即因政策自身次优决策所损失的回报。训练仅改变不匹配，而改变套件则同时影响这两个术语。因此，通过固定模型比较不同套件会混合每个套件提供的回报以及该模型利用它的效果。在MiniWoB++中，后训练使模型的偏好特定于其训练套件。颠倒观察字段的顺序会保持每个最优决策不变，但将训练好的模型的成功率从85.0%降至19.2%。相反，固定模型比较拒绝但能提高上限的每个新套件，在进一步训练后都会优于原始代理，而事先测量的上限和不匹配可以预测这些收益。对于Terminal-Bench Lite上的编码代理套件，用更强的模型作为替代最优模型来估计上限减去不匹配，能够重现准确率排名，而单独使用任一术语则无法做到。代码可在https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP获取。

articles.title: Aligning Large Language Models for Safety in African Languages: A Case Study of Hausa
articles.abstract: Safety alignment research for large language models (LLMs) remains concentrated on high-resource languages, leaving open how existing alignment methods perform in low-resource, culturally distinct settings. We study this question for Hausa, a language spoken by more than 200 million people across West Africa. We introduce HausaSafeLM, one of the first Hausa safety preference dataset, built from 10,000 prompts derived from PKU-SafeRLHF: 3,000 human-corrected (gold) and 7,000 machine-translated (silver) examples spanning six harm macro-categories. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, we compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and SFT followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) under both data regimes, evaluating on 500 harmful and 200 benign Hausa prompts.We find that the untuned base model appears highly safe by refusal-rate metrics alone, but this reflects limited Hausa generation ability rather than genuine alignment: its refusals are almost uniformly low quality. SFT improves both refusal fluency and precision and benefits substantially from the larger, noisier silver-tier data, while DPO sharpens refusal precision but comes at a steep, largely data-invariant cost to linguistic quality. No single configuration jointly maximizes safety, helpfulness, and fluency. Our results suggest that current alignment techniques teach models when to refuse more readily than how to do so fluently in underrepresented languages, and that refusal-rate metrics alone are an unreliable signal of safety in low-resource settings.
articles.titleCn: 为非洲语言中的大型语言模型进行安全对齐：以豪萨语为例
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐研究仍主要集中于资源丰富的语言，而现有对齐方法在低资源、文化差异显著环境中的表现尚不明确。我们以豪萨语（一种西非超过2亿人使用的语言）为例，研究了这一问题。我们介绍了豪萨SafeLM，这是首个豪萨语安全偏好数据集之一，由10,000个来自PKU-SafeRLHF的提示构建而成：3,000个人类校正（黄金）和7,000个机器翻译（白银）的示例，涵盖六大危害宏观类别。我们使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，在两种数据条件下比较了监督微调（SFT）和SFT后进行直接偏好优化（DPO），并在500个有害和200个无害的豪萨语提示上进行了评估。我们发现，未调优的基模型仅通过拒绝率指标就表现出高度安全性，但这反映的是有限的豪萨语生成能力而非真实对齐：其拒绝内容几乎普遍质量低下。SFT提升了拒绝流畅性和精确性，并从更大、更嘈杂的白银级数据中获益显著，而DPO则提高了拒绝精确性，但以对语言质量造成巨大且基本不受数据影响的代价为代价。没有单一配置能同时最大化安全性、有用性和流畅性。我们的结果表明，当前对齐技术更擅长教会模型何时拒绝，而非如何流畅地拒绝代表性不足的语言，并且仅凭拒绝率指标在低资源环境中无法可靠地反映安全性。

articles.title: Decision Models as Judges for Hallucination Detection
articles.abstract: Large language models are widely used as judges of model outputs (LLM-as-a-Judge), but they are costly and can hallucinate or be overconfident. Decision models are a potential alternative. They return a predefined verdict with a probability for each label instead of free-form text and are much cheaper and faster. We test this promise on hallucination detection. We build binary benchmarks for five hallucination types (9,852 items from six datasets) and compare five decision models with the generative judge gpt-6-sol. Performance depends strongly on the type: the best decision model matches gpt-6-sol in balanced accuracy on context inconsistency and comes within 3 percentage points on factual errors, but trails it by 4-8 points on logical and instruction inconsistency. Decision-model probabilities are overconfident, though less so than the GPT-6 models, and separate correct from incorrect decisions only moderately. We also find that a confidence cascade of decision models improves on the best single model by 1.9-3.3 points on three types and matches or exceeds gpt-6-sol at 1-3% of its cost. Overall, decision models are a practical low-cost judge for some hallucination types but need to be validated before use.
articles.titleCn: 决策模型作为幻觉检测的裁判
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型被广泛用作模型输出的评判者（LLM-as-a-Judge），但它们成本高昂，并且可能产生幻觉或过度自信。决策模型是一种潜在的替代方案。它们为每个标签返回一个预定义的裁决及其概率，而不是自由形式的文本，并且成本更低、速度更快。我们在幻觉检测方面测试了这一承诺。我们为五种幻觉类型（来自六个数据集的9,852个项目）构建了二元基准，并将五种决策模型与生成式裁判gpt-6-sol进行了比较。性能强烈依赖于类型：最佳决策模型在上下文不一致性上的均衡精度与gpt-6-sol相当，在事实性错误上相差3个百分点，但在逻辑和指令不一致性上落后4-8个百分点。决策模型的概率虽然比GPT-6模型不那么自信，但仍然过度自信，只能适度区分正确与错误的决策。我们还发现，决策模型的置信度级联在三种类型上比最佳单一模型提高了1.9-3.3个百分点，并在1-3%的成本下达到或超过gpt-6-sol的性能。总体而言，决策模型是某些幻觉类型的一种实用低成本裁判，但在使用前需要经过验证。

articles.title: Uncovering Shortcut Amplification in Video RLVR through the Lens of Perceptual Uncertainty Collapse
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for enhancing the video reasoning capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). Despite its empirical effectiveness, we show that outcome-level optimization can introduce an undesirable shortcut amplification effect, whereby models increasingly favor text-prior answers even when they are not supported by the visual evidence. To characterize this behavior, we investigate the training dynamics of video RLVR through the lens of perceptual uncertainty, analyzing how predictive uncertainty evolves under video-conditioned and text-only contexts. Our analysis identifies a perceptual uncertainty collapse phenomenon, in which RL training continuously sharpens the model's answer distribution while the uncertainty reduction attributable to visual evidence progressively diminishes. A further gradient-direction analysis reveals that such confidence enhancement becomes increasingly less aligned with visually grounded uncertainty reduction and is instead dominated by text-prior compression. Motivated by these findings, we propose Bifocal Self-distillation Policy Optimization (BSPO), a self-distillation framework that regulates policy updates with two complementary distributional signals. Specifically, BSPO derives empirical reasoning principles from intra-group correct and incorrect rollouts to identify reasoning-sensitive tokens, and introduces shortcut-aware visual perturbation to penalize predictions that remain invariant when task-relevant visual evidence is weakened. By adaptively reweighting the original RL advantage, BSPO preserves the task-solving benefits of RLVR while promoting updates that are both reasoning-sensitive and visually grounded. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of BSPO in improving video reasoning performance and strengthening visual faithfulness.
articles.titleCn: 通过感知不确定性坍塌的视角揭示视频RLVR中的捷径放大
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大型多模态模型（LMMs）视频推理能力的一种有效训练后范式。尽管其在实践中表现出效，但我们证明结果级优化可能引入一种不良的捷径放大效应，即模型在视觉证据不支持的情况下愈发倾向于依赖文本先验答案。为刻画此行为，我们通过感知不确定性的视角研究视频RLVR的训练动态，分析在视频条件化和纯文本环境下预测不确定性的演变。我们的分析揭示了一种感知不确定性崩溃现象，即RL训练持续锐化模型的答案分布，而视觉证据带来的不确定性降低效应则逐渐减弱。进一步的梯度方向分析表明，这种置信度增强与视觉基础的不确定性降低愈发不匹配，反而被文本先验压缩主导。基于这些发现，我们提出了双焦点自蒸馏策略优化（BSPO），这是一种通过两种互补的分布信号调节策略更新的自蒸馏框架。具体而言，BSPO从组内正确和错误的回滚中提取经验推理原则以识别推理敏感的标记，并引入捷径感知视觉扰动以惩罚在任务相关视觉证据减弱时仍保持不变预测。通过自适应地重新加权原始RL优势，BSPO在保留RLVR解决任务优势的同时，促进了推理敏感且视觉基础的更新。大量实验验证了BSPO在提升视频推理性能和增强视觉忠实度方面的有效性。

articles.title: Coverage Under Contradiction: A Benchmark for Negation-Aware Retrieval
articles.abstract: Coverage-evaluation benchmarks quantify whether retrieved evidence covers the different pieces of information needed to satisfy an information need. Existing benchmarks mostly consider factual claims that may already be known to pretrained retrieval components, leaving open whether retrievers find corpus evidence when it contradicts those priors. We study how retrievers behave when their parametric knowledge and the information in a corpus disagree. To do so, we develop a process to augment a nugget-based coverage benchmark with controlled contradictions. For each nugget, we create a negated counterpart and edit its supporting documents to support that negation while preserving the context. Applying this process to CoverageBench, a benchmark measuring information coverage, we create CoverageBench-Negate, spanning six datasets and roughly 63,000 original-edited evidence pairs (one per nugget-document link). We attach rich construction metadata to every pair and additionally provide out-of-family LLM judgments over all pairs and a human audit of a sample. In baseline experiments, BM25 separates original from edited near-twin evidence substantially better than dense retrievers (Qwen3 and Jina), which stay near chance. We release the benchmark on Hugging Face Datasets (nuggets, documents, pairs) together with the construction materials, including the prompts used to create it.
articles.titleCn: 矛盾下的覆盖范围：否定感知检索的基准
articles.abstractCn: 覆盖评估基准用于量化检索到的证据是否涵盖了满足信息需求所需的不同信息片段。现有基准主要考虑可能已被预训练检索组件知晓的事实声明，从而留下了检索器在语料库证据与这些先验知识相矛盾时能否找到语料库证据的疑问。我们研究了检索器在它们的参数知识与语料库信息不一致时的行为。为此，我们开发了一个在基于“信息核”（nugget）的覆盖基准中添加受控矛盾的过程。对于每个“信息核”，我们创建一个否定的对应版本，并编辑其支持性文档以支持该否定，同时保留上下文。将此过程应用于CoverageBench（一个衡量信息覆盖的基准），我们创建了CoverageBench-Negate，涵盖六个数据集，约63,000对原始编辑证据（每个“信息核-文档”链接一对）。我们为每一对附加了丰富的构建元数据，并额外提供了跨家族的大语言模型（LLM）对所有对的判断，以及对人样例的人工审核。在基线实验中，BM25将原始证据与编辑后的近双胞胎证据区分得远好于密集检索器（Qwen3和Jina），后者接近随机水平。我们在Hugging Face Datasets上发布了该基准（包括“信息核”、“文档”和“证据对”），并提供了构建材料，包括创建它的提示。

articles.title: What Survives Distillation? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of GPT-2 and DistilGPT-2
articles.abstract: Knowledge distillation compresses large language models into compact students that preserve aggregate metrics, yet the mechanistic consequences of depth-reduction distillation remain largely uncharacterized. This work applies linear CKA, logit lens analysis, attention pattern decomposition, sparse autoencoder feature statistics, and activation patching to compare GPT-2 and its six-layer student DistilGPT-2 across two canonical circuits: the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit and the Greater-Than (GT) circuit. The results reveal a compression-collapse dichotomy: the IOI circuit suffers complete mechanistic collapse (DistilGPT-2: 35.2% accuracy vs. 94.8%, zero name-mover preservation), while the GT circuit survives with 87.7% task performance recovery through active remapping of the teacher's layer-9 comparison head into student layer~4 (mean Pearson r = 0.945). These findings demonstrate that circuit compressibility governs mechanistic survival under distillation, and that aggregate metrics are insufficient diagnostics for circuit integrity.
articles.titleCn: 什么能在蒸馏中幸存？GPT-2和DistilGPT-2的机制可解释性研究
articles.abstractCn: 知识蒸馏将大型语言模型压缩成保留综合指标的紧凑型学生模型，但深度缩减蒸馏的机制性后果仍基本未得到表征。本研究应用线性中心核关联分析、logit透镜分析、注意力模式分解、稀疏自编码器特征统计和激活块修补等方法，比较了GPT-2及其六层学生模型DistilGPT-2在两个典型电路——间接宾语识别（IOI）电路和大于（GT）电路上的表现。结果揭示了一种压缩-坍缩二分现象：IOI电路完全出现机制性坍缩（DistilGPT-2准确率35.2%对比94.8%，零命名迁移保留），而GT电路通过将教师模型第九层比较头主动映射到学生模型第四层，以87.7%的任务性能恢复幸存（平均皮尔逊相关系数=0.945）。这些发现表明，电路可压缩性决定了蒸馏下的机制性存活，而综合指标不足以作为电路完整性的诊断标准。

articles.title: Mechanistic Failure Modes of Weight Pruning in Transformer Language Models
articles.abstract: Pruned language models are judged almost entirely by accuracy and perplexity, which assumes that preserved output behaviour implies preserved internal computation. We test this assumption with a factorial pruning study on GPT-2, crossing two importance criteria (magnitude, random), two component types (attention heads, MLP neurons) and three sparsity levels (3%, 50%, 70%). Using the fully characterised indirect object identification (IOI) circuit as ground truth, we measure circuit integrity with activation patching, path patching and direct logit attribution. We find two qualitatively distinct failure modes. Magnitude head pruning >= zeroes the circuit: output-facing heads are removed, and the model falls to near-chance. Magnitude neuron pruning at 30% inverts it: all 26 circuit heads remain intact, but Name Mover contributions flip sign, and the model systematically prefers the wrong name (17.7% accuracy). Perplexity ranks it as less damaged than random head pruning (74.6 vs 140.1). A replication of the Greater-Than circuit shows that the critical component type depends on the circuit's architecture. These results show that output metrics and structural checks can both miss mechanistic damage, motivating circuit-level causal analysis as a complementary evaluation of compressed language models.
articles.titleCn: Transformer语言模型中权重剪枝的机制性失效模式
articles.abstractCn: 剪枝语言模型几乎完全由准确性和困惑度来评判，这假设保留的输出行为意味着保留的内部计算。我们通过在GPT-2上进行因子分析剪枝研究来检验这一假设，交叉了两种重要性标准（幅度、随机）、两种组件类型（注意力头、MLP神经元）和三种稀疏度水平（3%、50%、70%）。使用完全表征的间接宾语识别（IOI）电路作为基准，我们通过激活补丁、路径补丁和直接逻辑归因来测量电路完整性。我们发现有两种定性的不同失效模式。幅度头剪枝会使电路归零：移除输出面向的头，模型跌至近似随机水平。幅度神经元剪枝在30%时会使电路反转：所有26个电路头保持完整，但Name Mover的贡献符号反转，模型系统性地偏好错误名称（准确率17.7%）。困惑度将其评为比随机头剪枝损伤更小的模型（74.6 vs 140.1）。对Greater-Than电路的复制实验表明，关键组件类型取决于电路架构。这些结果表明，输出指标和结构检查都可能遗漏机制性损伤，从而推动电路级因果分析作为压缩语言模型补充评估。

articles.title: Prospector: learning a compact graph traversal policy for scientific reasoning
articles.abstract: Scientific reasoning in specialized engineering fields depends on knowledge scattered across the literature, often proprietary and absent from frontier LLM training data. In such domains, frontier models tend to give generic answers. Knowledge graphs (KGs) can ground LLM reasoning. Because a graph is too large to provide in full, typical LLM+KG systems preselect a portion, deciding relevance before reasoning begins. Here we train a compact model, Prospector, to reason over a domain knowledge graph by traversing it step by step, seeking evidence in light of what it has already found. Prospector calls a small set of tools one at a time to progressively build its context, and answers with a chain of evidence that can be checked edge by edge against what its tools retrieved from the graph. On a knowledge graph built from the semiconductor-manufacturing literature, Prospector approaches the strongest off-the-shelf models given the same graph and tools, and it far exceeds off-the-shelf models answering closed-book or from a pre-selected portion of the graph. Although trained only on the semiconductor graph, Prospector transfers to unseen knowledge graphs from three other distinct fields: bio-inspired materials, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and materials properties. Served on a single GPU, Prospector answers faster and at a fraction of the cost of a hosted service, while keeping proprietary data on the owner's hardware. We find that the policy's latent state is indicative of its next move on both seen and unseen graphs, and modulating the latent state can steer the policy from one behavior mode to another. These results suggest a practical LLM + KG paradigm for scientific and engineering reasoning over private data, in which a compact model trained on a graph from published literature transfers its traversal to unseen graphs that stay with their owners.
articles.titleCn: 探针：为科学推理学习紧凑的图遍历策略
articles.abstractCn: 专业工程领域的科学推理依赖于文献中分散的知识，这些知识往往是专有的，并且没有包含在前沿大语言模型（LLM）的训练数据中。在这样的领域，前沿模型倾向于给出通用的答案。知识图谱（KG）可以为LLM推理提供基础。由于图谱太大无法完整提供，典型的LLM+KG系统会在推理开始前预先选择一部分内容，决定相关性。在这里，我们训练了一个紧凑模型Prospector，通过逐步遍历知识图谱进行推理，根据已经发现的信息寻找证据。Prospector逐个调用少量工具，逐步构建其上下文，并以证据链的形式回答，该证据链可以逐边检查其工具从图谱中检索到的信息。在一个基于半导体制造文献构建的知识图谱上，Prospector在给定相同的图谱和工具的情况下，接近了最强的现成模型，并且远远超过了从封闭环境或预先选择的部分图谱中回答的现成模型。尽管只在半导体图谱上训练，Prospector能够迁移到来自三个其他不同领域（仿生材料、全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）以及材料性能）的未见过知识图谱。在单个GPU上运行时，Prospector的响应速度更快，成本仅为托管服务的几分之一，同时将专有数据保留在所有者的硬件上。我们发现，策略的潜在状态可以指示其在已见和未见图谱上的下一步动作，调节潜在状态可以引导策略从一种行为模式转变为另一种行为模式。这些结果表明，对于私有数据的科学和工程推理，存在一种实用的LLM+KG范例，其中在已发表文献的图谱上训练的紧凑模型将其遍历过程迁移到属于所有者的未见过图谱上。

articles.title: Self-Regularized Flow Language Models
articles.abstract: We introduce SERF (Self-Regularized Flow Language Models), a simple self-supervised framework for improving continuous diffusion language models by exploiting the denoising trajectory itself. While continuous flow-based language models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, their training objectives typically rely on supervision from clean target tokens, leaving the denoising trajectory underexploited as a learning signal. SERF addresses this limitation through noisy-to-clean self-distillation: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher receives a cleaner version of the student's noisy input along the same interpolation path and provides additional supervision. We investigate two variants: SERF-L, which aligns the student's intermediate representations with deeper teacher representations, and SERF-P, which aligns their output token distributions, either at the student's output or at an early student layer. All variants augment the standard training objective without requiring external pretrained models or modifying the inference procedure. Experiments across three continuous language-model paradigms (one-hot FLM, latent ELF, and hyper-spherical S-FLM) demonstrate substantial improvements in training efficiency, generation quality, and few-step generation. In particular, SERF achieves up to 7.7x wall-clock training acceleration on OpenWebText, improves MAUVE by 24.3% and GSM8K accuracy by up to 28.8%, and matches baseline performance with up to 64x fewer sampling steps. These results establish noisy-to-clean self-distillation as an effective approach to improving continuous diffusion language models.
articles.titleCn: 自正则化流语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了SERF（自正则化流语言模型），这是一个通过利用去噪轨迹来改进连续扩散语言模型的简单自监督框架。虽然基于连续流的语言模型为自回归生成提供了有前景的替代方案，但它们的训练目标通常依赖于干净目标标记的监督，导致去噪轨迹作为学习信号未被充分利用。SERF通过噪声到干净的自我蒸馏来解决这一限制：一个指数移动平均（EMA）教师沿着相同的插值路径接收学生噪声输入的更干净版本，并提供额外的监督。我们研究了两种变体：SERF-L，它将学生的中间表示与更深的教师表示对齐，以及SERF-P，它将它们的输出标记分布对齐，无论是在学生的输出处还是在学生早期层。所有变体都在不要求外部预训练模型或修改推理程序的情况下增强了标准训练目标。在三种连续语言模型范式（one-hot FLM、潜在ELF和超球面S-FLM）上的实验表明，在训练效率、生成质量和少步生成方面都有显著改进。特别是，SERF在OpenWebText上实现了高达7.7倍的墙上时钟训练加速，将MAUVE提高了24.3%，将GSM8K准确率提高了高达28.8%，并且使用高达64倍的更少采样步骤达到了基线性能。这些结果确立了噪声到干净的自我蒸馏作为改进连续扩散语言模型的有效方法。

articles.title: Text Generation in Low-Resource Languages Using Human-Curated Vocabularies
articles.abstract: Synthetic text generation offers a promising approach to alleviating data scarcity in low-resource languages. However, its effectiveness is inherently limited for languages that are scarcely represented, or entirely absent, in an LLM's pretraining data. At the same time, many such languages have human-curated vocabularies that provide rich lexical and semantic information, often accompanied by grammatical information such as part-of-speech labels. In this work, we ask whether LLMs can leverage these resources to generate coherent text in extremely low-resource and unseen languages. We introduce a framework that combines human-curated vocabularies with a small number of human-written exemplars that provide syntactic signals, while sampling candidate words according to a Zipfian distribution. Across languages with varying levels of resource availability, we evaluate the generated text using lexical diversity, off-target ratio, and human judgments of fluency. Our results show that reasoning-enabled LLMs can generate fluent text even in extremely low-resource languages, with particularly strong results at the sentence level and promising performance at the paragraph level. Our findings highlight a practical pathway for bootstrapping synthetic data in low-resource languages, expanding the amount of usable text even when existing digital resources are extremely limited. Our source code is available at https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text.
articles.titleCn: 使用人工编辑词汇在低资源语言中进行文本生成
articles.abstractCn: 合成文本生成为缓解低资源语言的语料稀缺问题提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，对于在大型语言模型（LLM）预训练数据中鲜有代表性甚至完全缺失的语言，其有效性具有固有的局限性。与此同时，许多此类语言拥有人工编纂的词汇表，其中包含丰富的词汇和语义信息，通常还附带语法信息，如词性标注。在本工作中，我们探讨了LLM是否能够利用这些资源在极低资源且未见过的语言中生成连贯文本。我们提出了一种框架，该框架结合了人工编纂的词汇表和少量提供句法信号的人工编写示例，并根据齐夫分布采样候选词。在资源可用性不同的语言中，我们使用词汇多样性、离题率以及人类对流畅性的判断来评估生成的文本。我们的结果表明，具备推理能力的LLM即使在极低资源语言中也能生成流畅文本，在句子层面取得了尤为显著的结果，在段落层面也展现出有前景的表现。我们的研究突显了一种在低资源语言中引导合成数据生成的实用途径，即使现有数字资源极其有限，也能扩展可用文本的规模。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text获取。

articles.title: Hierarchical Low-Rank Reparameterization for Parameter-Efficient
articles.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods adapt large models by introducing a small number of trainable parameters. However, we find that these parameters still contain redundancy and can be further compressed while maintaining strong task performance. To this end, we propose a novel hierarchical low-rank reparameterization method. Its core idea is to reorganize the trainable parameters of PEFT methods into an approximately square matrix and then express it via a low-rank decomposition, which can be applied recursively. This forms a multi-level structure with factors compressed level by level, drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters. In our experiments, we combine this reparameterization with LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA. We evaluate commonsense reasoning on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, with additional GSM8K math reasoning experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B. Under comparable trainable-parameter budgets, our method combined with LoRA or DoRA achieves better performance. Furthermore,when the parameter count of the original methods is compressed by approximately an order of magnitude, our method can still maintain competitive task performance and even surpass the corresponding baselines in average accuracy across the eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks.
