articles.titleCn: 参数高效的层级低秩重新参数化
articles.abstractCn: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法通过引入少量可训练参数来适应大型模型。然而，我们发现这些参数仍然存在冗余，并且在保持强大任务性能的同时可以进一步压缩。为此，我们提出了一种新的分层低秩重新参数化方法。其核心思想是将PEFT方法的可训练参数重新组织成一个近似方阵，然后通过低秩分解来表示它，这可以递归地应用。这形成了一个逐级压缩因子的多级结构，大幅减少了可训练参数的数量。在我们的实验中，我们将这种重新参数化与LoRA、DoRA、MoSA和RaSA相结合。我们在LLaMA-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上评估常识推理，并在LLaMA-3.1-8B上进行额外的GSM8K数学推理实验。在可比的可训练参数预算下，我们的方法与LoRA或DoRA结合实现了更好的性能。此外，当原始方法的参数数量压缩约一个数量级时，我们的方法仍然可以保持有竞争力的任务性能，甚至在八个常识推理基准测试中的平均准确率上超越了相应的基线。

articles.title: EnergyCal: Taming Loss Spikes in Muon-Family Optimizers for Sparse MoE Training
articles.abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language-model training can exhibit large loss spikes with Muon-family optimizers. We introduce EnergyCal, a lightweight rule that attenuates routed-expert updates according to the normalized squared Frobenius norm of their finite-step Newton-Schulz directions. EnergyCal leaves the spectral transform unchanged and adds no persistent optimizer state. We evaluate it on a 4B-parameter MoE model. Against a development-selected, lower-learning-rate MuonH recipe, EnergyCal-MuonH reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06%, with a modest throughput cost. With plain Muon at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay, the reduction in mean spike burden averages 95.98% across the two tested exponents, accompanied by small endpoint improvements. These findings support stabilization both with and without Hyperball in the evaluated setting.
articles.titleCn: EnergyCal：用于稀疏MoE训练的μ子家族优化器中的损失峰值控制
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏专家混合（MoE）语言模型训练在使用Muon系列优化器时可能出现较大的损失峰值。我们引入了EnergyCal，这是一种轻量级规则，根据其有限步长的牛顿-舒尔茨方向的归一化平方Frobenius范数来减弱路由专家更新的幅度。EnergyCal保持频谱变换不变，且不增加持久的优化器状态。我们在一个4B参数的MoE模型上评估了它。与开发选定的低学习率MuonH配方相比，EnergyCal-MuonH将平均阈值损失峰值负担降低了99.51%，最终几何平均困惑度降低了4.06%，且吞吐量成本适中。在匹配的标称学习率和权重衰减下使用普通Muon，在两个测试指数上的平均峰值负担减少达到95.98%，并伴随着较小的终点改进。这些发现支持在评估设置下，无论是否使用Hyperball，都能实现稳定。

articles.title: Exploring the Limits of the Delta Learning Hypothesis: Single-Pair Generator Biases in Direct Preference Optimization
articles.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) typically relies on preference pairs generated from diverse model pools and ranked by an external LLM judge. The recently proposed delta-learning hypothesis suggests that comparable supervision can instead be obtained from a single pair of models by treating the larger model's response as preferred. We investigate the limits of this approach across model families and scales. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that fixed model pairs introduce systematic, generator-dependent biases that are predictive of the preference label independent of response quality. Consequently, DPO trained on single-pair data consistently underperforms multi-model preference data, despite the larger generator producing higher-quality responses, and we trace this gap to training dynamics consistent with reward hacking on these biases. We further show that simply increasing the number of generators, even without an external judge, is enough to partially mitigate this effect. Our results highlight generator diversity as a critical factor in preference-data construction.
articles.titleCn: 探索Delta学习假说的极限：直接偏好优化中的单对生成器偏差
articles.abstractCn: 直接偏好优化（DPO）通常依赖于从多样化的模型池中生成的偏好对，并由外部大型语言模型（LLM）裁判进行排序。最近提出的增量学习假说表明，可以通过将较大模型的响应视为更优来从一对模型中获得可比的监督。我们研究了这种方法在不同模型系列和规模上的局限性。我们通过理论和实证证明，固定模型对会引入系统性的、与生成器相关的偏差，这些偏差能够独立于响应质量预测偏好标签。因此，尽管较大的生成器能产生更高质量的响应，但在单对数据上训练的DPO始终不如多模型偏好数据表现好，我们将这种差距归因于与奖励攻击这些偏差一致的训练动态。我们进一步表明，即使没有外部裁判，仅增加生成器的数量就足以部分缓解这种效应。我们的结果突显了生成器多样性在偏好数据构建中的关键作用。

articles.title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Guided-RLVR consistently outperforms existing RLVR methods while producing more diverse reasoning trajectories.
articles.titleCn: 引导式RLVR：具有可验证奖励的强化学习中的引导式探索
articles.abstractCn: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大型语言模型（LLM）在数学和编程等任务上的推理能力方面已展现出显著的实证效果。然而，近期研究表明，RLVR的扩展过程往往收敛于狭窄的推理轨迹集，限制了探索的推理空间。受研究发现关键步骤中的思考标记是LLM推理路径中的关键结构元素这一启发，我们提出了Guided-RLVR，这是一种通过轻量级控制器增强RLVR的新方法。该控制器在采样分布中策略性地注入具有语义意义的引导标记，鼓励模型从多个推理视角解决问题，从而扩展探索空间。在数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，Guided-RLVR始终优于现有的RLVR方法，并能生成更多样化的推理轨迹。

articles.title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
articles.abstract: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.
articles.titleCn: 无需缩放即可放大 v2：从观察细节到连接证据，实现泛化多模态感知
articles.abstractCn: 多模态感知是多模态智能的基础。特别是空间感知和多模态长上下文理解是支撑具身人工智能和多模态代理的两个关键任务。然而，为这些任务合成目标性强、高质量的训练数据仍然困难且成本高昂。我们的核心洞察是，这些任务共享一种潜在能力，我们称之为连接证据：识别相关的视觉事实，将其绑定到正确的实体，恢复它们之间的关系，并将它们组合成答案。关键在于，针对这种能力合成目标性强、高质量的训练数据比直接合成这些任务本身要容易得多。为了增强这种能力，我们提出了EvidenceConnect，这是一个易于实现的训练数据合成框架，它利用图像内相关区域的全局视图来生成需要比较、聚合或串联视觉证据的问题。为确保质量，只有当独立视觉语言模型（VLM）对参考答案达成一致时，才会保留该参考答案，并且区域移除测试会丢弃那些在移除选定区域后仍能得出答案的问题。然后，我们使用RLVR在这些数据上训练基础VLM，得到Zooming without Zooming v2（ZwZ2）。尽管合成的数据并非针对任何下游基准，但ZwZ2提高了细粒度和空间感知能力，并在具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解、多模态代理任务和通用视觉推理方面取得了进一步提升。这些结果确立了EvidenceConnect作为监督证据连接的有效框架，并表明增强这种共享能力可以带来更具泛化的多模态感知。

articles.title: V-LUMEN: Visual Lookup Memory for Embedding Scaling in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth, width, or dense computation. Extending this idea to vision-language models (VLMs) is challenging because visual features are continuous, spatially structured, and query-dependent, unlike discrete text tokens that naturally support n-gram lookup. We introduce V-LUMEN, a visual lookup memory for VLMs. V-LUMEN discretizes visual features with a frozen codebook, builds spatially aware memory keys through spatial aggregation-based hashing, and modulates them with text-conditioned relevance signals; all addressing is non-parametric, and the retrieved embeddings are fused into the backbone through a gated residual pathway. On five reasoning-intensive benchmarks, V-LUMEN substantially improves a frozen Qwen3-VL-2B backbone and transfers zero-shot to three benchmarks whose images are disjoint from the training data. At a matched parameter budget, moving part of a LoRA or MoE adapter's capacity into V-LUMEN preserves accuracy on two backbones, indicating that external visual memory is an independent capacity axis rather than a stronger adaptation method. Because lookup cost is constant in table size and incurred only once at prefill, this capacity grows in storage rather than in per-token compute. Code is available at https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen.
articles.titleCn: V-LUMEN：视觉语言模型中嵌入规模扩展的视觉查找记忆
articles.abstractCn: 基于嵌入的缩放通过基于查找的内存扩展了语言模型的容量，而不是通过增加模型深度、宽度或密集计算。将这一思想扩展到视觉语言模型（VLMs）具有挑战性，因为视觉特征是连续的、空间结构的，并且依赖于查询，与自然支持n-gram查找的离散文本标记不同。我们引入了V-LUMEN，一种用于VLMs的视觉查找内存。V-LUMEN使用冻结的码本对视觉特征进行离散化，通过基于空间聚合的哈希构建空间感知的内存键，并使用文本条件的相关性信号对其进行调制；所有地址都是非参数化的，检索到的嵌入通过门控残差通路融合到主干网络中。在五个推理密集型基准测试中，V-LUMEN显著改进了一个冻结的Qwen3-VL-2B主干网络，并将零样本迁移到三个图像与训练数据不相关的基准测试。在匹配的参数预算下，将LoRA或MoE适配器的一部分容量转移到V-LUMEN可以在两个主干网络上保持准确性，这表明外部视觉内存是一个独立的容量轴，而不是一种更强的适应方法。由于查找成本在表大小中是恒定的，并且仅在预填充时一次性发生，因此这种容量在存储中增长，而不是在每个标记的计算中增长。代码可在https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen获取。

articles.title: SpectRAG: Weighted Chunk Graphs for Token-Budgeted Context Selection in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) by retrieving external evidence and conditioning generation on the retrieved context. Although dense retrieval is effective for local semantic matching, independently ranked retrieval can return redundant passages, miss cross-chunk dependencies, and provide incomplete evidence for multi-hop reasoning. We propose SpectRAG, a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework that combines hybrid candidate seeding, weighted chunk graph construction, graph-based expansion, spectral relevance propagation, and token-budgeted context selection. Document chunks are represented by dense semantic embeddings and graph-spectral coordinates derived from a weighted chunk graph whose edges encode semantic similarity, document adjacency, section hierarchy, shared entities, citation links, and similarity between LLM-generated utility questions. At query time, SpectRAG builds a high-recall seed set using exact inner-product search and hybrid relevance signals, expands it over the chunk graph, re-scores candidates using graph proximity and spectral information, and assembles the final context under a fixed token budget. The goal is not merely to retrieve individually similar chunks, but to construct a context that is relevant, diverse, structurally connected, and sufficient for grounded reasoning. Experiments on MultiHopRAG, UltraDomain, and long-document question-answering settings show that SpectRAG improves broad evidence recovery and achieves competitive generation quality against dense, hybrid, HyDE, LightRAG, and NaiveRAG baselines. The results further indicate that graph-spectral structure is particularly useful for inference-oriented and cross-document retrieval, while highlighting trade-offs in early precision, computational cost, and domain-dependent performance.

articles.titleCn: SpectRAG：用于多跳检索增强生成中的基于令牌预算的上下文选择的重块图
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过检索外部证据并对检索到的上下文进行条件生成来为大型语言模型（LLM）提供基础。尽管密集检索在局部语义匹配方面有效，但独立排序检索可能会返回冗余段落、忽略跨片段依赖，并为多跳推理提供不完整的证据。我们提出了SpectRAG，这是一个基于谱图增强的检索框架，它结合了混合候选种子、加权片段图构建、基于图的扩展、谱相关传播和基于令牌预算的上下文选择。文档片段由密集语义嵌入和加权片段图中推导出的图谱坐标表示，其边编码了语义相似性、文档邻接性、章节层次结构、共享实体、引用链接以及LLM生成的效用问题之间的相似性。在查询时，SpectRAG使用精确内积搜索和混合相关性信号构建高召回率的种子集，在片段图上对其进行扩展，使用图邻近性和谱信息重新对候选进行评分，并在固定的令牌预算下组装最终上下文。目标不仅是检索单个相似的片段，而是构建一个相关、多样、结构上连接且足以支持有据推理的上下文。在MultiHopRAG、UltraDomain和长文档问答设置上的实验表明，SpectRAG提高了广泛证据的恢复能力，并在密集、混合、HyDE、LightRAG和NaiveRAG基线模型中实现了具有竞争力的生成质量。结果进一步表明，图谱结构对于面向推理和跨文档检索特别有用，同时突出了早期精确度、计算成本和领域依赖性能之间的权衡。

articles.title: The State and Fate of Multilingual, Contextual Evaluation in the NLP World
articles.abstract: Multilingual evaluation benchmarks are the primary instrument for assessing whether large language models generalize beyond English, yet the adequacy of these benchmarks has received little systematic scrutiny. We present a data-driven audit of 51 recent multilingual benchmarks spanning 242 datasets and 219 languages, organized around three pillars: coverage, representativeness, and rigor. Our analysis reveals that coverage is wide but thin with 36% of evaluated languages appearing in only a single benchmark, entire regions (Oceania, the Americas, Central Asia) are near-zero, and a stark task equity gap leaves low-resource languages evaluated on only 1-3 task categories versus 14 for high-resource languages. Representativeness is structurally compromised: translation from English remains the dominant construction strategy where 56% of all dataset-language instances are translated introducing artifacts and English-centric framing, while culturally grounded content is concentrated in a handful of community-driven benchmarks with narrow language scope. The ecosystem thus forces a trade-off between breadth and validity. Rigor is undermined by benchmark contamination, including translated benchmark leakage and parallel corpus overlap that evade surface-form detection. We synthesize these findings into concrete recommendations for building evaluation frameworks that are natively constructed, culturally grounded, contamination-aware, and designed to serve the communities whose languages they claim to evaluate. The dashboard with all the metadata collected can be found at https://aka.ms/multilingual-evals.

articles.titleCn: 多语种、情境化评估在NLP领域中的现状与前景
articles.abstractCn: 多语言评估基准是评估大型语言模型是否超越英语进行泛化的主要工具，但这些基准的充分性却鲜少受到系统性审查。我们针对51个近期多语言基准进行了数据驱动的审计，涵盖242个数据集和219种语言，围绕三个支柱展开：覆盖范围、代表性及严谨性。我们的分析揭示，覆盖范围虽广但深度不足，36%的评估语言仅出现在一个基准中，整个区域（大洋洲、美洲、中亚）几乎为零，任务公平性差距明显，低资源语言仅被评估1-3个任务类别，而高资源语言则有14个。代表性结构受损：英语翻译仍是主导构建策略，56%的数据集-语言实例被翻译，引入了人工痕迹和以英语为中心的框架，而文化相关内容则集中在少数社区驱动基准中，语言范围狭窄。生态系统迫使我们在广度与有效性之间做出权衡。基准的严谨性因污染而受损，包括翻译基准泄露和并行语料库重叠等难以被表面形式检测的问题。我们将这些发现总结为具体建议，用于构建原生构建、文化扎根、污染感知且服务于其所声称评估的语言社区的评估框架。收集的所有元数据仪表板可在https://aka.ms/multilingual-evals找到。

articles.title: AutoVend: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Vending Operations
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending agent-mediated commerce on the Web from shopping for consumers to operating businesses for sellers. In online-to-offline (O2O) commerce, decisions are issued through Web-based platforms but realized through costly physical execution. Evaluating such agents requires going beyond individual transactions to ask whether decisions made online turn into sustained economic returns. We introduce AutoVend, a benchmark in which one LLM agent manages 20 vending machines across five site types through a Web-based operating interface for 180 simulated days. Its data-grounded simulator combines a shared warehouse, procurement lead times, paid replenishment, inventory expiration, and recurring operating costs. We evaluate five LLM agents against a rule-based inventory-control baseline and diagnose their site coordination, execution, and performance over time. Four of five evaluated LLM agents fall short of this baseline, and returns per dollar of inference cost rank models differently from returns alone. Operational analyses show that gains in individual metrics do not consistently yield stronger economic growth, as inventory and execution costs erode these gains. Trajectory analysis further reveals difficulties in grounding feasible actions, managing inventory commitments, and converting feedback into effective policy revisions.
articles.titleCn: AutoVend：在长时自主售货操作中对大型语言模型代理进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理正在将基于代理的电子商务从为消费者购物扩展到为卖家经营业务。在线上线下（O2O）电子商务中，决策通过基于网络的平台发布，但通过昂贵的物理执行来实现。评估此类代理需要超越单个交易，去询问在线做出的决策是否转化为持续的经济回报。我们介绍了AutoVend，这是一个基准，其中一个LLM代理通过基于网络的操作系统管理五个不同类型的20台自动售货机，模拟运行180天。其数据驱动的模拟器结合了共享仓库、采购提前期、付费补货、库存过期和定期运营成本。我们评估了五个LLM代理，并与基于规则的库存控制基线进行比较，诊断了它们在时间推移中的站点协调、执行和性能。五个被评估的LLM代理中有四个未能达到该基线，每美元推理成本的回报与单独的回报排名不同。运营分析表明，单个指标的提升并不始终带来更强的经济增长，因为库存和执行成本侵蚀了这些收益。轨迹分析进一步揭示了在确定可行行动、管理库存承诺以及将反馈转化为有效政策修订方面存在的困难。

articles.title: Mining the Nineteenth Century for the Thirteenth: Register-Scale Forced Alignment and HTR Bootstrapping via Legacy Regesta and Antiquarian Editions
articles.abstract: Handwritten text recognition (HTR) for the registers of Pope Honorius III depends on modern expert transcriptions, which exist only for regnal years 1-2 of Reg. Vat. 9. For the remaining registers, nineteenth-century scholarship offers Pressutti's regesta and partial editions. On fol. 1-203, where both layers exist, we measure what this legacy layer can contribute, on transcriptions that we first audit against it, and find a division of labor across three tiers. At the orthographic tier, raw editions are at best neutral for adapting a recognizer to the second regnal year and harmful without replay, whereas projection onto curial spelling with replay of modern source lines turns them into zero-label adaptation targets: pooled over all 134 year-2 sides, the WER falls by 1.50 points (95% CI -1.84 to -1.15), closing 33% of the gap to an oracle; the spelling changes at the year split, through the scribe or the transcriber, whereas the hand changes visibly only at fol. 191r. At the lexical tier, the corpus-wide legacy lexicon contains 82.2% of the out-of-vocabulary words of unedited entries and flags recognition errors with 66.7% precision, and labels from pre-trained medieval NER models, distilled into the recognizer's NER head, reach F1 82.1% on an expert validated benchmark, level with the best tagger applied after recognition. At the topological tier, Pressutti's regests, the closing datum clauses, and the regests' dates converted to the chancery's Roman form find 73.9% of entry starts in the recognized line stream, and edition agreement estimates a CER of 7.80% beyond fol. 203. Antiquarian scholarship thus cannot replace modern transcription, but it can steer, check, and segment HTR across the untranscribed registers.
articles.titleCn: 从十九世纪挖掘十三世纪：基于传统档案和古版文献的注册级强制对齐和高通量文本识别自举
articles.abstractCn: 对教皇霍诺留三世登记册的手写文本识别（HTR）依赖于现代专家转录，而这些转录仅存在于梵蒂冈图书馆第9号档案册（Reg. Vat. 9）的1-2年统治期间。对于其余的登记册，19世纪的学术研究提供了Pressutti的登记册索引和部分版本。在1-203页，两层文本都存在的地方，我们测量了这一传统层能够贡献什么，首先将其转录与该层进行审计，发现存在三个层面的分工。在正字法层面，原始版本在适应识别器到第二年统治期间最多是中性的，在不重放的情况下是有害的，而将现代来源行投影到教廷拼写并重放时，它们变成了零标签适应目标：在所有134页的2年统治期间，WER降低了1.50分（95%置信区间为-1.84至-1.15），缩小了33%与理想识别器的差距；拼写变化发生在年份分割处，无论是由抄写员还是转录员造成的，而手写变化在191r页明显可见。在词汇层面，整个语料库的传统词汇包含了未编辑条目中82.2%的未登录词，并以66.7%的精度标记识别错误，而来自预训练的中世纪命名实体识别（NER）模型的标签，提炼到识别器的NER头部，在专家验证基准上达到了82.1%的F1分数，与识别后应用的最好标记器相当。在拓扑层面，Pressutti的登记册索引、关闭的条款数据以及将登记册日期转换为文书处的罗马形式，在识别的行流中找到了73.9%的条目起始位置，而版本一致性估计在203页之后为7.80%的CER。因此，古董学术研究不能取代现代转录，但它可以引导、检查和分割未转录登记册的HTR。

articles.title: Self-Keyed In-Parameter Memorization for External Memory-Free Dialogue Recall in Frozen Language Models
articles.abstract: A large language model maintains conversational content in an external storage that is outside the model and grows as the dialogue continues. This work assumes an environment where a language model has no external memory and no prior knowledge of the future question or its answer. The motivation is to research whether a dialogue can be stored in the model parameters and later answer a question about it. This work proposes self-keyed in-parameter memorization (SKIM), a closed-form method in which the model generates its own questions about each dialogue turn and writes those questions into its parameters as the keys that later retrieve the turn's content. Generating many varied questions for each turn allows a later user question to match one even when phrased differently, and its answer is recalled from the parameters alone. Evaluated on five language models, SKIM recalls most stored dialogue turns from later user questions, and it answers from the model parameters without any external storage.
articles.titleCn: 冻结语言模型中无需外部内存的对话召回的自键入参数记忆
articles.abstractCn: 一种大型语言模型在模型外部维护对话内容，该存储空间会随着对话的进行而增长。这项工作假设语言模型没有外部记忆，也不具备对未来问题或其答案的先验知识。其动机在于研究对话内容是否能够存储在模型参数中，并稍后根据该内容回答问题。这项工作提出了自键参数记忆（SKIM），这是一种封闭形式的方法，其中模型会为每个对话回合生成自己的问题，并将这些问题写入其参数中作为稍后检索该回合内容的键。为每个回合生成许多多样化的问题，使得稍后的用户问题即使措辞不同也能匹配其中之一，而其答案则仅从参数中回忆。在五个语言模型上的评估表明，SKIM能够从稍后的用户问题中回忆起大多数存储的对话回合，并且它仅从模型参数中回答问题，无需任何外部存储。

articles.title: JevRec: Linguistic Encoding with Jev-like Decision Modeling for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
articles.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items as semantic identifiers (SIDs) and autoregressively generates the next item's SID from interaction history. However, most methods assign the same SID length to all items despite highly unequal interaction frequencies. This uniform design repeatedly incurs the cost of fine-grained codes for popular items, while shortening codes to reduce this cost also compresses the semantic representations of long-tail items. Inspired by the compact forms of frequent expressions in natural language, we propose JevRec to encode items as variable-length words and generate the next item from interaction context. Linguistic encoding retains frequency-dependent semantic prefixes from shared codebooks, producing shorter SIDs for popular items and richer descriptions for long-tail items. Yet predicting a sequence-level length and generating token-level content impose different optimization requirements that may conflict under a shared output head. Our Jev-like decision modeling component therefore predicts a length distribution with a dedicated head and generates content conditioned on length through a separate head while sharing the interaction-history representation. Experiments on three public datasets show that JevRec outperforms all compared baselines across the evaluated recommendation metrics. Further analyses show lower training and inference time than TIGER and reduced gradient conflict between length and content prediction.
articles.titleCn: JevRec：基于Jev-like决策模型的LLM生成式推荐语言编码
articles.abstractCn: 生成式推荐（GR）将物品表示为语义标识符（SIDs），并从交互历史中自回归地生成下一个物品的SID。然而，大多数方法对所有物品分配相同的SID长度，尽管它们的交互频率差异很大。这种统一设计反复导致对热门物品进行细粒度编码的成本，而缩短编码以降低这种成本则会压缩长尾物品的语义表示。受自然语言中频繁表达紧凑形式的启发，我们提出了JevRec，将物品编码为可变长度的词，并根据交互上下文生成下一个物品。语言编码保留了来自共享码本的频率相关的语义前缀，为热门物品生成更短的SID，并为长尾物品提供更丰富的描述。然而，预测序列级长度和生成标记级内容在共享输出头下可能存在冲突的不同优化需求。因此，我们的Jev类决策建模组件使用专用头预测长度分布，并通过单独的头根据长度生成内容，同时共享交互历史表示。在三个公共数据集上的实验表明，JevRec在评估的推荐指标上优于所有比较基线。进一步分析显示，与TIGER相比，训练和推理时间更低，且长度和内容预测之间的梯度冲突减少。

articles.title: DocXEval: A Systematic Evaluation of Explainability in Multimodal Document Understanding
articles.abstract: Multimodal transformer models have driven unprecedented performance breakthroughs in modern document understanding. However, the inherent black-box nature of these models remains a major obstacle to their safe deployment in high-stakes sectors. Despite significant progress in explainability for vision and language tasks, explainable AI (XAI) research tailored to multimodal document understanding has received little attention. To address this gap, we present \ourframework{}, the first comprehensive explainability framework that adapts existing XAI methods and evaluation metrics to the multimodal (text, layout, and image) document understanding context, while introducing efficient multi-target adaptations of both methods and metrics for domain-specific tasks such as semantic entity recognition. Using \ourframework{}, we systematically evaluate 13 XAI methods across 3 document understanding tasks, 8 datasets, 4 models, and 17 evaluation metrics, and find that only a few methods perform consistently across all evaluation criteria, with Occlusion emerging as the most faithful and interpretable method overall. Through a dedicated meta-evaluation, we observe moderate to strong agreement among several faithfulness and complexity metrics while identifying certain ones that produce unreliable results. Finally, through multiple dataset-wide diagnostic analyses, we uncover key insights into model behavior, including the contribution of individual modalities across tasks and labels, spatial attribution patterns around target entities, and potential dataset biases. Overall, this work serves as both a benchmark and a practical guide for future XAI research in multimodal document understanding. To support reproducibility, we publicly release our code at https://github.com/saifullah3396/docxeval/.
articles.titleCn: DocXEval：多模态文档理解中可解释性的系统评估
articles.abstractCn: 多模态Transformer模型在现代文档理解领域取得了前所未有的性能突破。然而，这些模型固有的黑盒特性仍然是其在高风险领域安全部署的主要障碍。尽管在视觉和语言任务的可解释性方面取得了显著进展，但针对多模态文档理解的可解释人工智能（XAI）研究却鲜受关注。为填补这一空白，我们提出了\ourframework{}，这是首个将现有XAI方法和评估指标适配到多模态（文本、布局和图像）文档理解环境中的综合性可解释性框架，同时为特定领域任务（如语义实体识别）引入了高效的多目标方法与指标适配。利用\ourframework{}，我们对13种XAI方法在3项文档理解任务、8个数据集、4个模型和17种评估指标上进行了系统评估，发现仅有少数方法在所有评估标准下表现一致，其中遮挡法（Occlusion）总体上被认为是最忠实且最易于解释的方法。通过专门的元评估，我们观察到多个忠实度与复杂度指标之间存在中等至强的一致性，同时识别出某些产生不可靠结果的指标。最后，通过多次跨数据集的诊断分析，我们揭示了模型行为的关键洞察，包括不同模态在任务和标签中的贡献、目标实体周围的空间归因模式以及潜在的数据集偏差。总体而言，这项工作为未来多模态文档理解领域的XAI研究提供了基准和实用指南。为支持可重复性，我们公开发布了代码，地址为https://github.com/saifullah3396/docxeval/。

articles.title: TrawMem: Reframing Agent Memory as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on memory systems to leverage long-term interactions, yet existing systems typically retrieve memories based on their relevance to the current query and use them as contextual evidence. However, relevance alone does not characterize how a memory contributes to task solving: the same memory may serve different roles across tasks, such as directly supporting the answer or linking to complementary memories with weaker semantic relevance but necessary information. We therefore reframe agent memory systems as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces, where memories are selected and organized by their task-oriented roles and relations. Based on this view, we propose TrawMem, which organizes interaction histories into local threads and constructs task-oriented workspaces by assigning roles and jointly selecting complementary memories. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemGallery with four open- and closed-source backbones show consistent improvements over representative memory systems, with macro-F1 gains of 2.23-3.14 points. On LoCoMo, TrawMem improves the LLM-Judge score over SimpleMem by 4.07 and 4.31 percentage points on Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, respectively, while requiring approximately 12.8% and 5.1% fewer context tokens, respectively.
articles.titleCn: TrawMem：将智能体记忆重构为面向任务的适应性角色工作空间
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理依赖于记忆系统来利用长期交互，但现有系统通常根据记忆与当前查询的相关性来检索记忆，并将其作为上下文证据使用。然而，相关性本身并不能表征记忆如何有助于任务解决：同一记忆在不同任务中可能扮演不同角色，例如直接支持答案或链接到语义相关性较弱但包含必要信息的互补记忆。因此，我们将代理记忆系统重新定义为面向任务的适应性角色工作空间，其中记忆根据其面向任务的角色和关系进行选择和组织。基于这一观点，我们提出了TrawMem，该系统将交互历史组织成本地线程，并通过分配角色和联合选择互补记忆来构建面向任务的工作空间。在LoCoMo和MemGallery上的实验，使用四种开源和闭源主干网络，均显示出对代表性记忆系统的持续改进，宏观F1提升2.23至3.14个百分点。在LoCoMo上，TrawMem在Qwen3.5-9B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash上分别比SimpleMem提升了4.07和4.31个百分点，同时分别减少了约12.8%和5.1%的上下文token。

articles.title: Do We Need an LLM to Know Why Sources Conflict? Decision Models for Knowledge-Conflict Typing in RAG
articles.abstract: When the sources retrieved for a query disagree, the right response depends on why they disagree: a question with several valid answers, a contested topic, stale information and a false source each call for different behaviour. Cattan et al. (2025) showed that telling a generator the conflict type improves its responses by about 24 points, but that predicting the type is hard even for frontier LLMs. We study whether typed decision models, which return probabilities over fixed options in a single forward pass instead of generating text, can do this classification fast and cheaply. Using the CONFLICTS benchmark and the original paper's prompt verbatim, we evaluate all 11 decision models served by one commercial inference gateway, from 7 providers, against Gemini models on identical inputs. Asked directly, the decision models reach 50.0--67.0% accuracy; 10 of the 11 match or exceed Gemini 2.5 Flash, the paper's model (61.3%), at 4--39x lower billed cost (2 were free) and 2.6--6.0x lower latency. The current Gemini 3.8 Flash (70.0%) is significantly more accurate than 8 of them, but sending each decision model's least confident quarter of queries to it gives a cascade statistically tied with it for 8 of the 11, at 25--37% of its cost. End to end, answers generated with the types of 10 of the 11 follow the expected behaviour as often as with the LLM's types. Decomposing the taxonomy into yes/no questions lowers accuracy for every model, and a repair fitted on one model does not transfer. Pre-specified diagnostics show that dates play no measurable role and that sensitivity to source order varies widely between models. Decision models detect a planted false source less reliably than the LLM as hard labels, but their probabilities still separate planted from clean sources. We release code, prompts and all model outputs at https://github.com/Parv17k/decision-models-conflict-typing.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Code, prompts and all model outputs: https://github.com/Parv17k/decision-models-conflict-typing
articles.titleCn: 我们是否需要大型语言模型来了解信息来源为何冲突？用于RAG中的知识冲突类型决策模型
articles.abstractCn: 当为查询检索到的来源存在分歧时，正确的响应取决于它们分歧的原因：一个有多个有效答案的问题、一个有争议的话题、过时的信息和虚假来源都要求不同的行为。Cattan等人（2025年）表明，告知生成器冲突类型可将其响应准确率提高约24分，但即使是前沿的大型语言模型（LLM）也很难预测类型。我们研究了是否可以通过单次前向传递返回固定选项概率的带类型决策模型，能够快速且经济地进行此类分类。使用CONFLICTS基准和原始论文的提示原文，我们评估了由一个商业推理网关提供、来自7个供应商的11个决策模型，在相同输入下与Gemini模型的表现。直接询问时，决策模型的准确率达到50.0%至67.0%；其中10个模型的表现与或优于论文中的模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash，61.3%），且成本降低了4至39倍（其中2个免费），延迟降低了2.6至6.0倍。当前的Gemini 3.8 Flash（70.0%）显著优于其中的8个模型，但将每个决策模型最不自信的四分之一查询发送给它，在11个模型中的8个上，其表现与该模型统计上持平，且成本仅为其25%至37%。整体而言，11个模型中有10个生成的答案在行为上与LLM的类型一样符合预期。将分类法分解为是/否问题会降低所有模型的准确率，且在一个模型上拟合的修复措施无法迁移。预定义的诊断显示日期没有可测量的作用，而模型对来源顺序的敏感性差异很大。决策模型在作为硬标签检测植入的虚假来源时不如LLM可靠，但它们的概率仍然能区分植入的来源和干净来源。我们已将代码、提示和所有模型输出发布在https://github.com/Parv17k/decision-models-conflict-typing。

articles.title: Developing a Speech Language Model for Basque
articles.abstract: Although the recent development of LLMs has paved the way for multi-modal interaction, minority languages face difficulties keeping pace. This work presents the first open Speech Language Model for Basque, designed for low-latency, end-to-end spoken interaction. Based on the LLaMA-Omni architecture, the system integrates a Latxa model as its backbone, transferring its Basque capabilities to the spoken modality by fine-tuning several modules. To address data scarcity, the English VoiceAssistant-400K corpus was translated into Basque, and the audio was synthesized using a Basque TTS. Evaluation results confirm the system's viability, achieving 3.86/5 in content quality, a 9.94% WER for spoken intelligibility, and a 3.07 UTMOS for audio quality. This work demonstrates that advanced spoken interaction systems can be developed using modular architectures and synthetic data even in low-resource languages.

articles.titleCn: 为巴斯克语开发语音语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型的近期发展促进了多模态交互，但少数语言在跟上步伐方面面临困难。这项工作提出了首个用于巴斯克语的开放语音语言模型，旨在实现低延迟、端到端的语音交互。基于LLaMA-Omni架构，该系统集成了Latxa模型作为其骨干，通过微调多个模块将其巴斯克语能力迁移到语音模态。为解决数据稀缺问题，将英语VoiceAssistant-400K语料库翻译成巴斯克语，并使用巴斯克语音合成技术生成音频。评估结果表明该系统的可行性，在内容质量方面达到3.86/5，语音可懂度方面达到9.94%的词错误率，音频质量方面达到3.07的UTMOS。这项工作证明，即使在低资源语言中，也可以使用模块化架构和合成数据开发出先进的语音交互系统。

articles.title: Nothing Left Behind: Finding Evidence from a Large Randomized Evaluation Corpus
articles.abstract: Many AI systems need to find every relevant items in a large collection and then organize what they found. The standard way to do this is to tag each item with labels from a curated vocabulary and search on those labels. Those labels are useful for organizing results, but searching on them misses items that do not fit a label and returns too much when labels are broad. We compare this approach with an embedding-based approach: find candidates by meaning using text embeddings, then have a language model keep only the relevant ones. In a corpus of 7,354 randomized trials, label search found 45% of the evidence a systematic review would include, while the new approach found 92%, at a cost per query that rises with search depth. These results support a two-stage architecture that combines broad candidate retrieval with query-specific evidence filtering.
articles.titleCn: 不留痕迹：从大型随机评估语料库中寻找证据
articles.abstractCn: 许多AI系统需要在一个大型集合中找到所有相关的项目，然后对找到的内容进行组织。标准的方法是使用经过精心策划的词汇库为每个项目添加标签，并基于这些标签进行搜索。这些标签对于组织结果很有用，但基于标签的搜索会遗漏不符合标签的项目，并且在标签过于宽泛时返回过多结果。我们将其与基于嵌入的方法进行比较：通过文本嵌入按意义查找候选项目，然后使用语言模型保留相关项目。在一个包含7,354项随机试验的语料库中，标签搜索找到了系统评价会包含的证据的45%，而新方法找到了92%，但查询成本会随着搜索深度增加。这些结果支持一种两阶段架构，该架构结合了宽泛的候选检索和针对查询的证据过滤。

articles.title: HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it. This creates two coupled challenges: predicting useful content before reasoning is complete, and deciding when to fix answer tokens that shape later predictions. We identify budget-induced premature commitment: even when a correct solution fits, the model can fix answer fragments near the window boundary before resolving intermediate steps. These fragments become context for later predictions and redirect subsequent reasoning. Existing post-training methods do not directly transfer the stronger trajectories that the same model follows with a larger window. HiLo-RD addresses this gap by (1) pairing large-window teacher states with cropped small-window views and (2) matching their hidden representations at committed positions. This supervision guides both token prediction and commitment order without an external teacher. Across mathematics benchmarks, HiLo-RD improves low-budget accuracy and shortens responses; these gains extend to code generation without code-domain training. On GSM8K, accuracy rises by 9.4 percentage points as mean readable length falls by about 25%. Attention diagnostics and fixed-budget order interventions support the proposed mechanism. Together, these results show that large-window reasoning can improve small-window decoding.
articles.titleCn: HiLo-RD：跨预算自蒸馏技术用于掩码扩散语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了HiLo-RD（高到低预算表示蒸馏）方法，旨在提升在有限生成预算下的掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）。与自回归模型不同，MDLMs需要选择生成的内容以及确定分配的位置，这带来了两个相互关联的挑战：在推理完成前预测有用内容，以及决定何时固定那些影响后续预测的答案标记。我们识别出预算诱导的过早固定问题：即使存在正确解，模型也可能在解决中间步骤之前，就固定了靠近窗口边界的答案片段。这些片段成为后续预测的上下文，并引导后续推理。现有的后训练方法无法直接迁移同一模型在更大窗口下遵循的更强轨迹。HiLo-RD通过（1）将大窗口教师状态与裁剪的小窗口视图配对，以及（2）在固定位置匹配它们的隐藏表示，来弥补这一差距。这种监督指导了标记预测和固定顺序，无需外部教师。在数学基准测试中，HiLo-RD提升了低预算下的准确率并缩短了响应长度；这些改进也适用于无需代码域训练的代码生成任务。在GSM8K上，随着平均可读长度的减少约25%，准确率提升了9.4个百分点。注意力诊断和固定预算顺序干预支持了所提出机制的有效性。综合这些结果，表明大窗口推理可以提升小窗口解码性能。

articles.title: RubricAtlas: Mining Type-Level Rubrics from Expert Reports to Evaluate Deep Research Agents
articles.abstract: Deep research agents conduct multi-step Web searches and synthesise retrieved information into analytical reports. Evaluating these outputs requires checking which analyses they deliver, beyond the presence of relevant facts. Query-specific binary rubrics make individual requirements explicit, but task-level checklists may leave the overall analytical structure underexamined. We introduce RubricAtlas, which derives type-level analytical requirements from expert reports on different objects within the same research type and organises detailed checks around recurring analytical questions. The requirements give related tasks a shared standard for what to analyse, without prescribing their answers. Our framework links binary checkpoints to report passages and evaluates completeness separately from argument validity. Built from 3,079 Chinese financial research reports, RubricAtlas covers 99 research types. Reference-report selection experiments show that individual reports cover only about half of their type's analytical questions, and that selecting requirements from different reports changes evaluation scores and agent rankings. Across ten agents, two judge pipelines achieve checkpoint agreement of $κ$ = 0.71 and agent-ranking agreement of Kendall $τ$ = 0.87. Controlled deletions reduce scores on the affected analyses, while padding produces no detectable increase. These findings support type-level rubrics for comparing the analytical completeness of Web deep research outputs, with individual decisions traceable to report evidence.
articles.titleCn: RubricAtlas：从专家报告中挖掘类型级评分标准以评估深度研究代理
articles.abstractCn: 深度研究代理执行多步网络搜索，并将检索到的信息综合成分析报告。评估这些输出需要检查它们提供哪些分析，而不仅仅是相关事实的存在。针对特定查询的二进制评分标准使个体要求明确化，但任务级别的检查清单可能使整体分析结构未得到充分审视。我们介绍了RubricAtlas，它从同一研究类型内不同对象的专业报告中推导出类型级别的分析要求，并将详细检查围绕反复出现的分析问题进行组织。这些要求为相关任务提供了一个共同的标凊，用于分析内容，但并不规定答案。我们的框架将二进制检查点与报告段落相链接，并将完整性评估与论证有效性评估分开。基于3079份中文金融研究报告构建的RubricAtlas涵盖了99种研究类型。参考报告选择实验表明，单个报告仅覆盖其类型分析问题的约一半，而从未个报告中选择要求会改变评估分数和代理排名。在十个代理中，两个判断流程实现了检查点协议的κ=0.71和代理排名的Kendall τ=0.87。受控删除会降低受影响分析的成绩，而填充操作未产生可检测到的增加。这些发现支持使用类型级别评分标准来比较网络深度研究输出的分析完整性，且个体决策可追溯至报告证据。

articles.title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
articles.abstract: Mobile GUI agents are typically fine-tuned 7B-scale vision-language models (VLMs) that generate each action as text. However, these VLMs decode every action token by token, and even agents that score candidate actions keep a large language model or VLM in the loop, making them slow and memory-hungry. To address these issues, we propose GUI-JEPA, to our knowledge the first decoder-free GUI agent policy built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which selects actions in the latent space of a JEPA encoder pretrained on unlabelled GUI screenshots. Its action- and region-conditioned latent predictor turns the screen latent into one latent per candidate action, letting lightweight heads score all candidates against the instruction in a single batched pass, without decoding a token. We further show that the scorer relies on this latent pathway and that the predictor is trained for the decision itself: a randomly initialised predictor does just as well as one pretrained on screen dynamics. On AndroidControl, GUI-JEPA is 2.8-4.0x faster on the same GPU than a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent we fine-tune with the same inputs, while reaching 86-92% of its in-distribution accuracy with 6% of its parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA
articles.titleCn: GUI-JEPA：以候选条件JEPA潜空间作为移动GUI代理的快速动作策略
articles.abstractCn: 移动GUI代理通常是经过微调的7B规模视觉语言模型（VLM），它们将每个动作生成文本。然而，这些VLM逐个解码每个动作标记，即使评分候选动作的代理也保持一个大型语言模型或VLM在循环中，这使得它们速度慢且内存消耗大。为解决这些问题，我们提出了GUI-JEPA，据我们所知，这是基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）构建的第一个无解码器GUI代理策略，它选择动作是在预训练于无标签GUI截图的JEPA编码器的潜在空间中。其动作和区域条件潜在预测器将屏幕潜在转换为每个候选动作一个潜在，让轻量级头部在单个批量通过中，无需解码标记，就针对所有候选动作与指令进行评分。我们进一步表明，评分器依赖于这个潜在路径，并且预测器是为决策本身进行训练的：一个随机初始化的预测器与一个在屏幕动态上预训练的预测器表现一样好。在AndroidControl上，GUI-JEPA在相同的GPU上比我们用相同输入微调的Qwen2.5-VL-7B代理快2.8-4.0倍，同时达到其分布内准确性的86-92%，参数量仅为6%。代码可在https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA获取。

articles.title: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
articles.abstract: GUI grounding on high-resolution screens fails mostly on small targets, and zooming in is a common training-free remedy. However, most existing zooming pipelines do not match the zoom to the target's size, accept the zoomed answer unconditionally and never revisit a wrong answer. To address these issues, we propose AdaGround, a training-free framework with three components: (1) Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming, which sets the magnification, field of view and zoom depth of each sample from the model's own estimate of the target size; (2) Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement, which uses one marked-click Yes/No verifier to keep or reject each zoom, choose between zoom chains, trigger re-grounding and, with an existence query, decide when to abstain; and (3) Compositional Structure Grounding, which composes spreadsheet cells from their headers. On Qwen3-VL models, AdaGround surpasses state-of-the-art training-free zooming methods and many trained GUI models, improving accuracy over the backbone by 7.4 to 20.6 points on OSWorld-G and ScreenSpot-Pro, and its gains carry over to held-out UI-Vision. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/AdaGround
articles.titleCn: AdaGround：一种基于令牌归一化自适应缩放，并包含验证器循环细化的GUI grounding方法
articles.abstractCn: 在高分辨率屏幕上，图形界面（GUI）定位主要在小目标上失败，缩放是常见的无需训练的补救措施。然而，大多数现有的缩放流程未能根据目标大小进行匹配，无条件接受缩放后的答案，并且永远不会重新审视错误答案。为解决这些问题，我们提出了AdaGround，一个无需训练的框架，包含三个组件：（1）标记归一化的自适应缩放，该组件根据模型对目标大小的估计来设置每个样本的放大倍数、视场和缩放深度；（2）循环中的验证器细化，该组件使用一个标记点击的Yes/No验证器来决定保留或拒绝每次缩放，在缩放链之间进行选择，触发重新定位，并通过存在查询决定何时放弃；（3）组合结构定位，该组件从其标题组合电子表格单元格。在Qwen3-VL模型上，AdaGround超越了最先进的无需训练的缩放方法以及许多训练的GUI模型，在OSWorld-G和ScreenSpot-Pro上，其准确度比主干模型提高了7.4到20.6个百分点，并且其收益也体现在保留的UI-Vision上。代码可在https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/AdaGround获取。

articles.title: Words or Deeds? How LLMs Predict Users' Decisions in Human-Agent Dialogue
articles.abstract: Web systems increasingly predict users' decisions from what users say, yet when interests partly conflict, users may promise to cooperate to win the other side's cooperation and then not do so. Sales or service agents that rely on such promises may grant concessions to users who then do not keep their promises, at a cost to the party they represent. We test how LLMs combine users' statements with decision records to predict users' decisions, using 1,260 rounds in which 42 users played a repeated prisoner's dilemma-style game with five agents, each prompted to express a dominant Big Five trait, and could talk with the agent before every decision. Across eight open-weight LLMs, predictions from decision records separated cooperation from defection well (AUC = .80), and adding dialogue brought no detectable gain. With dialogue, predictions agreed with users' statements more often, and errors concentrated on rounds in which users broke their statements: accuracy on rounds with a statement barely changed (.73 to .74), while it rose on kept statements (.76 to .95) and fell sharply on broken ones (.65 to .17). Predictions weighted statements more heavily than users' behavior warranted: when users stated a decision they had not yet made in that game, the predicted probability of keeping it rose from .13 to .69, whereas users kept .40 of such statements. Users' decisions also varied with the agent they faced, but predictions hardly reflected this: users cooperated more with the Agreeableness agent than with the Extraversion agent (70.6% vs. 54.5%), whereas predicted cooperation was nearly identical (64.5% vs. 63.1%). Users also cooperated more with an agent when they themselves scored higher on that agent's trait, whereas predicted cooperation barely changed with these scores. Dialogue-based predictions should therefore weigh users' statements by their earlier decisions and the agent they face.
articles.titleCn: 言语还是行动？大型语言模型如何预测人类-代理对话中的用户决策
articles.abstractCn: 随着网络系统越来越多地根据用户的言论预测其决策，但当利益部分冲突时，用户可能会承诺合作以换取对方合作，然后又不履行承诺。依赖此类承诺的销售或服务代理可能会向不履行承诺的用户让步，从而损害其所代表的利益方。我们测试了大型语言模型（LLMs）如何结合用户的言论与决策记录来预测用户决策，实验中42名用户与五个被提示表达主导五大性格特质（Big Five）的代理进行了1260轮重复囚徒困境式博弈，并在每轮决策前可以与代理交谈。在八种开放权重LLMs中，基于决策记录的预测能很好地将合作与背叛区分开来（AUC = 0.80），而添加对话并未带来可察觉的增益。在对话情境下，预测与用户的言论更为一致，且错误集中在用户违背言论的回合：含有言论的回合准确率几乎未变（0.73至0.74），而遵守言论的回合准确率显著提高（0.76至0.95），违背言论的回合准确率则急剧下降（0.65至0.17）。预测对言论的权重超过了用户行为所支持的权重：当用户声明在该游戏中尚未做出的决策时，预测的保持概率从0.13上升到0.69，而用户实际遵守了其中的40%。用户的决策也因面对的代理而异，但预测几乎未能反映这一点：用户与宜人性（Agreeableness）代理的合作率高于与外向性（Extraversion）代理（70.6% vs. 54.5%），而预测的合作率几乎相同（64.5% vs. 63.1%）。当用户自身在该代理的特质上得分较高时，他们与代理的合作率也更高，而预测的合作率随这些得分几乎未变。因此，基于对话的预测应结合用户早期的决策以及他们面对的代理来权衡用户的言论。

articles.title: Weakness Localization Is Not Enough: State-Aware Recursive Knowledge Improvement for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Knowledge improvement in large language models is shifting from predefined knowledge incorporation pipelines toward evaluation-guided updating. Existing methods use evaluation to localize model-specific knowledge weaknesses and guide targeted post-training. However, identifying what to improve does not necessarily provide sufficient information for deciding how to improve it. The same localized weakness can be compatible with distinct operational knowledge states: the relevant knowledge may be unavailable, available but difficult to access reliably, or accessible but ineffective for downstream use. We call this ambiguity knowledge-state aliasing. When compatible states favor different interventions, greater diagnostic resolution alone is insufficient for intervention selection. Moreover, model updates can change the underlying knowledge state before the observed weakness disappears, such that an intervention appropriate in one round may no longer address the bottleneck in the next. To address these challenges, we propose Recursive Knowledge Improvement (RKI), which formulates knowledge improvement as a sequential, state-aware intervention process. RKI organizes knowledge into graph-structured units that provide a shared basis for diagnostic evaluation and targeted intervention across rounds. At each round, RKI localizes knowledge weaknesses, estimates the model's operational knowledge state from diagnostic evidence and intervention history, selects a corresponding intervention, and re-evaluates the updated model before determining the next intervention. On HotpotEval and SafeInternalEval, RKI outperforms existing knowledge incorporation methods by 18.41 points on average. Further analyses show that knowledge states provide additional guidance for intervention selection beyond weakness localization and can change across model updates even when the observed weakness persists.
articles.titleCn: 弱点定位不足：针对大型语言模型的状态感知递归知识改进
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的知识改进正从预定义的知识整合流程转向评估引导的更新。现有方法利用评估来定位模型特定的知识弱点，并指导针对性的后训练。然而，识别要改进的内容并不一定为决定如何改进提供充分信息。相同的局部弱点可能与不同的操作知识状态兼容：相关知识可能不可用，可用但难以可靠访问，或可访问但对下游任务无效。我们称这种现象为知识状态别名。当兼容状态倾向于不同的干预措施时，仅提高诊断分辨率不足以选择干预措施。此外，模型更新可能改变底层知识状态，而观察到的弱点消失之前，因此上一轮适当的干预措施可能无法解决下一轮的瓶颈。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了递归知识改进（RKI），将知识改进表述为一个序列化、状态感知的干预过程。RKI将知识组织成图结构单元，为跨轮次的诊断评估和针对性干预提供共同基础。在每一轮中，RKI定位知识弱点，根据诊断证据和干预历史估计模型的操作知识状态，选择相应的干预措施，并在确定下一干预措施之前重新评估更新后的模型。在HotpotEval和SafeInternalEval上，RKI平均优于现有的知识整合方法18.41分。进一步分析表明，知识状态在定位弱点之外为干预选择提供了额外指导，即使在观察到的弱点持续存在时，知识状态也可能在模型更新中发生变化。

articles.title: Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning with Multi-Branch Exploration
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models have made substantial progress in visual question answering, but complex visual reasoning often requires locating and comparing multiple pieces of question-relevant visual evidence. Existing methods that move intermediate reasoning into the visual latent space usually follow a single linear reasoning trajectory, which can be limiting when multiple visual hypotheses or competing evidence regions are relevant. We propose Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning, a branch-aware latent reasoning framework that generates multiple question-conditioned latent visual branches as soft hypotheses over image tokens. To train these branches, our method uses bounding-box evidence annotations to build target evidence representations and introduces a soft contrastive branch-evidence alignment objective. This objective encourages evidence-relevant branches to align with annotated visual regions while contrasting them against negative evidence. We instantiate our method on Qwen2.5-VL backbones and train it with standard supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on perception-intensive visual reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves overall improvements over the corresponding backbone and single-path latent reasoning baselines at both 3B and 7B scales.
articles.titleCn: 基于多分支探索的潜在视觉对比推理
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型在视觉问答领域取得了显著进展，但复杂的视觉推理通常需要定位和比较多个与问题相关的视觉证据。现有的将中间推理移至视觉潜在空间的方法通常遵循单一的线性推理轨迹，这在涉及多个视觉假设或竞争证据区域时可能存在局限性。我们提出了潜在视觉对比推理（Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning），这是一个分支感知的潜在推理框架，它生成多个问题条件化的潜在视觉分支，作为图像标记上的软假设。为了训练这些分支，我们的方法使用边界框证据标注来构建目标证据表示，并引入了一个软对比分支-证据对齐目标。该目标鼓励与证据相关的分支与标注的视觉区域对齐，同时与负证据进行对比。我们在Qwen2.5-VL主干上实例化我们的方法，并使用标准的监督微调进行训练。在感知密集型视觉推理基准测试上的实验表明，所提出的方法在3B和7B规模上均实现了相对于相应主干和单路径潜在推理基线的整体改进。

articles.title: Personality Latents: Conditioning Frozen Language Models on Individuals from Their Own Writing
articles.abstract: Controlling the personality of a language model usually relies on written profiles or named trait categories, so it can only express what an author writes down or what a taxonomy names. We instead propose Personality Latents (PL), which learn a latent for each person from their own writing, with no personality labels and no authored profile, and inject it into a frozen language model as a soft prefix. Following generative latent optimization, each training person receives a free latent that is optimized through the frozen model itself, while an encoder learns to predict these latents so that a new person needs only one forward pass, with optional refinement at test time. We evaluate on held-out people by having the conditioned model answer neutral and interview questions and reading personality from its answers with scorers trained on real human writing. On the MBTI axes PL reaches an AUC of , ahead of persona embedding and prompt-based baselines under identical settings, and the ranking holds when the answers are scored in three different embedding spaces. A latent learned with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct also transfers personality to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct through a new adapter alone.
articles.titleCn: 人格潜变量：基于个人写作对其自身的冻结语言模型进行条件化
articles.abstractCn: 控制语言模型的个性通常依赖于书面简介或命名特征类别，因此它只能表达作者写下的内容或分类体系所命名的特征。我们提出了一种名为个性潜空间（Personality Latents, PL）的方法，该方法从每个人的写作中学习一个潜空间，无需个性标签和作者简介，并将其作为软前缀注入冻结的语言模型中。通过生成式潜空间优化，每个训练个体获得一个由冻结模型本身进行优化的自由潜空间，同时编码器学习预测这些潜空间，使得新个体只需一次前向传递，并在测试时可选进行微调。我们在留出的个体上进行了评估，通过让条件化模型回答中立和面试问题，并使用在真实人类写作上训练的评分者从其回答中读取个性。在MBTI轴上，PL达到了AUC，在相同设置下优于角色嵌入和基于提示的基线，且当回答在不同嵌入空间中评分时，排名依然保持。使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct学习到的潜空间也能通过一个新适配器将个性迁移到Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。

articles.title: API-TAIL: Detecting Model Substitution in LLM APIs through Temperature-Aligned Likelihood Tails
articles.abstract: Commercial language model APIs return only text, allowing a provider to cut costs by quietly routing a fraction of user requests to a cheaper substitute model while billing for the advertised one. Detecting such partial substitution is challenging because honest providers also alter the output distribution through undocumented decoding and serving choices, such as temperature scaling, sampling truncation, repetition and presence penalties, and default system prompts, forcing an audit to test against a composite null of legitimate configurations rather than a single reference. Our key insight is that these legitimate variations primarily shift response typicality across the entire batch, whereas partial substitution injects individual responses that remain anomalous under the claimed model. Building on this, we introduce API-TAIL, a typicality audit that first absorbs batch-level shifts by aligning a single effective temperature to center standardized surprisal scores across the audited batch, and then flags the endpoint if the number of remaining tail responses exceeds a threshold calibrated across legitimate configurations. Evaluated on real-world commercial APIs, API-TAIL reliably controls false alarms across diverse honest providers while detecting even low-rate partial substitution with a small query budget, substantially outperforming existing rank- and MMD-based audits that lose detection power under the same composite calibration.
articles.titleCn: API-TAIL：通过温度对齐似然尾部检测大型语言模型API中的模型替换
articles.abstractCn: 商业语言模型API仅返回文本，允许提供商通过将部分用户请求悄悄路由到更便宜的替代模型来降低成本，同时仍然对宣传的模型进行收费。检测这种部分替代是具有挑战性的，因为诚实的提供商也会通过未公开的解码和服务选择来改变输出分布，例如温度缩放、采样截断、重复和存在惩罚以及默认系统提示，这迫使审计需要针对合法配置的组合空值进行测试，而不是单一参考。我们的关键洞察是，这些合法的变化主要是在整个批次中移动响应典型性，而部分替代则注入保持异常的个别响应，这些响应在声称的模型下仍然异常。基于这一点，我们引入了API-TAIL，这是一种典型性审计，它首先通过将单个有效温度与审计批次中标准化的惊讶分数中心对齐来吸收批次级别的变化，然后如果剩余尾部响应的数量超过合法配置校准过程中校准的阈值，则标记端点。在真实世界的商业API上评估，API-TAIL可靠地控制了不同诚实提供商的误报，同时以较小的查询预算检测到低率的部分替代，显著优于现有的基于排序和MMD的审计，这些审计在相同的组合校准下会失去检测能力。

articles.title: Language Models Keep Abandoned Analyses: Residue and Adaptation after Garden-Path Sentences
articles.abstract: Reading "While the man hunted the deer ran into the woods" requires giving up the analysis in which "the deer" is the object of "hunted". People who have just read such a sentence still produce more transitive structures, so the abandoned analysis primes later language. We ask whether language models keep using an analysis they have abandoned, and what in the model carries it. In 24 open models from 124M to 70B parameters, a garden-path sentence leaves two traces in the context. A residue of the abandoned analysis raises later object attachment, by about three quarters of the effect of a sentence in which the noun phrase really is an object, and it appears in sampled text, on held-out and human-normed items and for a second type of garden path. An adaptation toward the resolved structure scales with the sentence's disambiguation error and acts mainly on comprehension-like measures. Activation patching separates the two. Later text reads the residue from the role information in the noun phrase's states, which were computed under the object analysis before the disambiguation, and replacing these states removes almost all of the residue in the 32B and 70B models. The adaptation is read from the states that processed the disambiguation. Overridden statements show the same persistence (a corrected value keeps pulling later predictions in 8 of 9 models), and in most models the pull is carried by the positions after the statement. Finally, the human paradigm transfers only with controls for punctuation, because the models also write garden-path sentences themselves, which reverses the paradigm's raw statistic.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型保留废弃分析：花园路径句后的残留与适应
articles.abstractCn: 阅读“While the man hunted, the deer ran into the woods”需要放弃对“the deer”是“hunted”宾语的分析。刚读完这种句子的人仍然会产出更多及物结构，因此被放弃的分析会 prime 后续语言。我们询问语言模型是否持续使用已被放弃的分析，以及模型中承载这种分析的是什么。在124M到70B参数的24个开放模型中，一个歧义句在上下文中留下两种痕迹。被放弃分析的残留会提升后续宾语依附，其效果约为一个名词短语真正作为宾语的句子的四分之三，并出现在采样文本、保留项和人类校准项中，以及第二种歧义句中。对已解析结构的适应与句子的消歧误差成正比，主要作用于类似理解的指标。激活补丁将两者区分开来。后续文本从名词短语状态中的角色信息中读取残留，这些状态是在消歧前根据宾语分析计算的，替换这些状态几乎消除了32B和70B模型中的残留。适应是从处理消歧的状态中读取的。被覆盖的陈述显示出同样的持久性（在9个模型中的8个模型中，修正值持续拉动后续预测），并且在大多数模型中，这种拉动由陈述后的位置承载。最后，人类范式仅在与标点符号控制相关时转移，因为模型也会自己写出歧义句，这会逆转范式的原始统计数据。

articles.title: Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training
articles.abstract: Test-time training (TTT) enables a deployed language model to internalize incoming context on-the-fly into a small set of fast-weight parameters, rather than merely treating it as transient context for attention. In-Place TTT recently made this idea practical for large language models by repurposing the down-projection of standard MLP blocks as fast weights. However, we find that its benefit largely disappears on realistic web long-context question answering. We attribute this to In-Place TTT's uniform write schedule: every chunk is written with equal strength, so irrelevant content dilutes query-relevant information in fast-weight memory. Building on this insight, we propose Select-TTT, a model-agnostic, query-conditioned rule for In-Place TTT that scales each chunk's write strength by its relevance to the user query. This relevance signal requires no supervision and no new parameters: it is read directly from the model's frozen output head, as the probability mass that a chunk's hidden states assign to the query tokens. A temperature-scaled softmax turns these scores into learning-rate multipliers, leaving the chunk-wise, context-parallel computation of In-Place TTT intact. Select-TTT consistently improves long-context question answering on two benchmarks and two backbones. These findings highlight the value of query-conditioned fast weight writes for practical test-time training on long-context question answering, which is also potentially promising for long-horizon agent tasks involving multiple user queries over evolving contexts.
articles.titleCn: Select-TTT：查询条件选择性快速权重更新用于原位测试时训练
articles.abstractCn: 测试时训练（TTT）使部署的语言模型能够即时将输入的上下文内化到一小部分快速权重参数中，而不是仅仅将其视为注意力机制中的瞬时上下文。就地TTT最近通过将标准MLP模块的降投影重新用作快速权重，使这一想法对大型语言模型变得实用。然而，我们发现它在真实的网络长上下文问答任务上的优势几乎消失。我们将此归因于就地TTT的统一写入调度：每个片段都以相同的强度写入，因此无关内容会稀释快速权重内存中的与查询相关的信息。基于这一见解，我们提出了Select-TTT，这是一种模型无关、查询条件化的就地TTT规则，它根据每个片段与用户查询的相关性来调整其写入强度。这种相关性信号无需监督，也无需新参数：它直接从模型冻结的输出头读取，作为片段的隐藏状态分配给查询标记的概率质量。温度缩放的softmax将这些分数转换为学习率乘数，同时保留了就地TTT的片段级、上下文并行计算。Select-TTT在两个基准测试和两个主干网络上始终如一地提高了长上下文问答的性能。这些发现突出了查询条件化快速权重写入在长上下文问答的实际测试时训练中的价值，这也有可能为涉及多个用户查询在演变上下文中进行的长时程代理任务带来前景。

articles.title: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better
articles.abstract: Reflective text optimization makes agentic systems better, but the optimization loop is itself a resource-hungry workload whose sequential structure leaves parallel evaluation capacity idle. We extend the open-source GEPA optimizer to propose and evaluate a batch of candidates on each optimization step instead of one candidate at a time. In our sweep on two tasks, most batched runs finished in half the wall-clock time or less, and the fastest in about a quarter to a third. Batched settings also achieved higher held-out test scores, from 68.9% to 72.1% on LiveBench-Math (with $2\times2$) and from 49.0% to 60.0% on HoVer (with $8\times1$). A simple runtime model explains the measured speedups under a finite worker pool, and batched settings also spend their metric-call and dollar budgets more efficiently. We frame the axes along which a reflective optimization step can scale in parallel, a first look at allocating a fixed optimization budget across them.
articles.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI. 9 pages, 7 figures. First four authors contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/gepa-ai/gepa
articles.titleCn: 批量处理反射优化循环：并行建议使GEPA更快更好
articles.abstractCn: 反射式文本优化能够提升自主系统的性能，但优化循环本身是一个资源密集型的工作负载，其顺序结构导致并行评估能力闲置。我们扩展了开源的GEPA优化器，提出在每次优化步骤中批量评估候选方案，而非逐个评估。在我们的两项任务测试中，大多数批量运行在时钟时间的一半或更短时间内完成，最快的只需约四分之一到三分之一的时间。批量设置还实现了更高的保留测试分数，在LiveBench-Math（使用$2\times2$）上从68.9%提升至72.1%，在HoVer（使用$8\times1$）上从49.0%提升至60.0%。一个简单的运行时模型解释了在有限工作池下测得的加速效果，并且批量设置在指标调用和美元预算的分配上也更为高效。我们定义了反射式优化步骤可以并行扩展的维度，这是首次尝试在固定优化预算下分配这些维度。

articles.title: DocSkill: Skill-Integrated Agentic Reasoning for Multilingual Multi-Hop Document Question Answering
articles.abstract: Multilingual multi-hop document question answering (MMHop-DocQA) requires locating and integrating evidence across complex layouts, document pages, and diverse languages. Existing approaches include single-pass processing and adaptive tool use, but learning to coordinate evidence acquisition, cross-page integration, and answer verification remains challenging. To address this challenge, we present DocSkill, an agentic framework with a learned skill-orchestration policy for adaptive evidence acquisition and reasoning. The policy selects, revisits, or skips skills according to the evolving evidence state. To construct supervision for skill orchestration, bounded Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) explores alternative skill trajectories offline. These trajectories provide demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We further introduce MMHop-DocBench, a multilingual multi-hop document QA dataset with training and test splits, containing 60K QA pairs across 10 languages and eight document domains. Its HopGen pipeline builds hierarchical page-element graphs to derive traceable cross-page evidence paths and generate grounded QA pairs with page- and element-level evidence annotations. Experiments show that DocSkill with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves 41.0 accuracy and 49.2 F1 on MMHop-DocBench, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 5.5 and 6.3 points, respectively, and achieving competitive performance on MMLongBench-Doc and DocBench.
articles.titleCn: DocSkill：面向多语言多跳文档问答的技能集成智能推理
articles.abstractCn: 多语言多跳文档问答（MMHop-DocQA）需要在复杂的布局、文档页面和多种语言中定位并整合证据。现有方法包括单次处理和自适应工具使用，但学习如何协调证据获取、跨页整合和答案验证仍然具有挑战性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了DocSkill，一个具有学习技能编排策略的智能体框架，用于自适应证据获取和推理。该策略根据不断变化的证据状态选择、重访或跳过技能。为构建技能编排的监督信号，有界蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）在离线环境中探索替代技能轨迹。这些轨迹为监督微调（SFT）提供演示，并为直接偏好优化（DPO）提供偏好对。我们进一步引入了MMHop-DocBench，这是一个多语言多跳文档问答数据集，包含训练集和测试集，涵盖10种语言和8个文档领域，共60K个问答对。其HopGen流程构建分层页面元素图，以导出可追溯的跨页证据路径，并生成带有页面和元素级证据标注的可靠问答对。实验表明，DocSkill配合Qwen3-VL-8B在MMHop-DocBench上实现了41.0的准确率和49.2的F1值，分别比最强的评估基线高出5.5和6.3个百分点，并在MMLongBench-Doc和DocBench上取得了具有竞争力的表现。

articles.title: CAMR: Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay for Continual Learning in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Continual learning requires large language models to acquire new knowledge and capabilities while retaining what they have learned. Fine-tuning and replay support acquisition and retention, but deciding whether incoming examples need supervision and which historical examples to revisit remains a challenge. We propose Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay (CAMR), an adaptive framework that jointly controls current-example supervision and historical replay. CAMR combines compatibility checks with a learned memory gate to guide an online policy over three actions: learning incoming examples with general replay, jointly reinforcing compatible related examples, and skipping direct supervision of verified mastered duplicates. The policy learns from acquisition, retention, and training-cost feedback under a bounded per-arrival replay budget. We evaluate CAMR with Qwen3-8B-Base on continual factual updating and cross-task and cross-domain learning. On WikiBigEdit, CAMR consistently leads evaluated methods in Original Match from 3K to 100K facts, reaching 93.66% after just 3K facts and surpassing Full-history Replay (LoRA) after 100K facts. It also achieves the highest final scores on all four selected TRACE tasks and maintains or improves earlier-task performance relative to post-acquisition levels in a sequence spanning financial question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and summarization.
articles.titleCn: CAMR：适用于大型语言模型的持续学习兼容性感知内存重放
articles.abstractCn: 持续学习要求大型语言模型在获取新知识和能力的同时保留已学知识。微调和重放支持知识获取和保持，但判断新输入示例是否需要监督以及哪些历史示例需要重访仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了兼容性感知记忆重放（CAMR），这是一个自适应框架，联合控制当前示例监督和历史重放。CAMR结合兼容性检查和学习记忆门来指导在线策略，该策略涵盖三种动作：使用通用重放学习新输入示例、联合强化兼容的相关示例，以及跳过已验证掌握的重复示例的直接监督。策略在有限的每到达重放预算下，从获取、保持和训练成本反馈中学习。我们使用Qwen3-8B-Base在持续事实更新、跨任务和跨领域学习上评估CAMR。在WikiBigEdit上，CAMR在3K到100K事实的原始匹配任务中始终领先于评估方法，仅3K事实后即达到93.66%，并在100K事实后超越全历史重放（LoRA）。它还在所有四个选定的TRACE任务上取得了最高最终分数，并在涵盖金融问答、数学推理、代码生成和摘要的序列中，相对于获取后的水平，保持了或提高了早期任务的性能。

articles.title: A Harness Reducing over-Defensive Writing in Agents by Isolating Objections
articles.abstract: When expanding a report, writing with agents may introduce a stronger claim than the article makes and then disclaim it. This is called over-defensive writing. We assume that this is because the agent is writing for responding to an adversarial AI reviewer, instead of a human reader. The defensive context may also influnce the consequent when we simply ban defensive writing in the output through prompts. In order to reduce over-defensive writing, we produce a harness that separates the reviewer, filter, and writer. The writer agent receives only the problems choosen by the filter, which is an independent context. We evaluate this harness on 25 business-project drafts expanded into formal reports, the result shows that the defensive propositions decreased from 59 to 2, which is a 96.61\% reduction, no unsupported factual additions were identified while the source-claim retention rises from 80.35% to 93.12%.
articles.titleCn: 通过隔离异议来减少代理中的过度防御性写作
articles.abstractCn: 在扩展报告时，使用代理进行写作可能会引入比文章本身更强的主张，然后又撤回这些主张。这被称为过度防御性写作。我们假设这是因为代理是为应对对抗性的人工智能审稿人而写作，而不是为人类读者而写。防御性语境也可能影响我们通过提示简单地禁止输出中的防御性写作时的结果。为了减少过度防御性写作，我们开发了一个将审稿人、过滤器与写作者分离的装置。写作者代理只接收过滤器选择的问题，这是一个独立的环境。我们在25份商业项目草稿扩展成的正式报告中评估了这个装置，结果显示防御性主张从59减少到2，降幅达96.61%，同时未发现任何未经支持的事实性添加，而源主张保留率从80.35%上升到93.12%。

articles.title: Is Token Confidence Just Chain Length? A Signal-Processing Audit of Reasoning Traces
articles.abstract: Reasoning language models answer math problems by writing long chains of thought, and sampling many chains per problem and taking a majority vote raises accuracy at a large cost in generated text. A popular way to cut that cost scores each chain by the model's confidence in each token it writes, where a token is a word or part of a word. The method averages this confidence over a sliding window of 2048 tokens and keeps or stops chains based on the lowest average. We treat the confidence, recorded token by token, as a signal in the sense of audio or radio, and examine the method with standard signal-processing tools such as spectral analysis and statistical tests for detecting a sudden change. We sampled 16 chains for each of 500 problems from two math benchmarks with a small open reasoning model. The windowed-minimum score turns out to measure mostly how long a chain is. Ranking chains by length alone does as well as or better than the confidence score, and once length is accounted for the score carries no information about correctness. Signal processing explains why: the minimum of a longer stretch of a slowly drifting signal is lower by chance alone, and the confidence signal drifts slowly enough that this effect dominates. The spectrum does hold a small signal that length does not explain, since incorrect chains carry more rapid token-to-token fluctuation, but it is too weak to improve the vote. For stopping chains early, neither the sliding average nor a classical change detector beats the simpler choice of sampling fewer chains.
articles.titleCn: Token置信度仅仅是链长吗？推理轨迹的信号处理审计
articles.abstractCn: 推理语言模型通过生成长链的思考来回答数学问题，并且对每个问题采样多个链并取多数投票来提高准确率，但这会以生成大量文本为代价。一种流行的降低成本的方法是通过对模型写入的每个标记（标记是单词或单词的一部分）的置信度进行评分，然后对2048个标记的滑动窗口内的置信度进行平均，并根据最低平均值来保留或停止链。我们将每个标记记录的置信度视为音频或无线电中的信号，并使用频谱分析和检测突然变化的统计测试等标准信号处理工具来检验该方法。我们从两个数学基准测试中用一个小型开放式推理模型对每个问题采样了16个链。结果表明，窗口最小分数主要衡量链的长度。仅根据长度对链进行排序的效果与置信度分数一样好，甚至更好，一旦考虑了长度，分数就不再包含关于正确性的信息。信号处理解释了原因：较长的一段缓慢漂移信号的极小值纯粹由偶然因素导致较低，而置信度信号漂移缓慢，这种效应占主导地位。频谱确实包含长度无法解释的小信号，因为错误的链包含更多快速的标记间波动，但它太弱了，无法改进投票结果。对于提前停止链，滑动平均值或经典变化检测器都不及简单地选择采样较少链的方法。

articles.title: Specialization, Diversity, and Scaling in Child-Scale Language Models
articles.abstract: Modern language models are trained on far more language than children experience, but we know much less about learning from small, naturalistic datasets. We train small GPT-2 models on transcripts of speech with children from dense home recordings (BabyView) and on synthetic child-directed dialogue (TinyDialogues), varying the amount, source, and diversity of training data. Models trained on one child's language environment predict that environment substantially better than other children's environments. Much of this specialization is lexical and distributional: a simple 5-gram model reproduces the cross-child pattern (r=.91). Training on data from multiple children clearly improves prediction of pooled held-out language relative to training on a single child's input without a similarly clear improvement on grammatical benchmarks. Across data sizes, naturalistic and synthetic training inputs also produce different grammatical and lexical-semantic patterns, with important differences between grammatical phenomena. Together, these results show that small-data language learning depends not only on how much language a model sees, but on which environments it comes from and how well that input matches what the model is asked to predict.
articles.titleCn: 儿童规模语言模型的专精、多样与扩展
articles.abstractCn: 现代语言模型在训练时所接触的语言远超儿童的实际体验，但我们对于从小型、自然数据集中学习了解甚少。我们使用儿童密集家庭录音（BabyView）中的语音转录文本以及合成儿童对话数据集（TinyDialogues）来训练小型GPT-2模型，并改变了训练数据量、来源和多样性。在单一儿童语言环境中训练的模型，其预测该环境的能力显著优于其他儿童环境。这种特殊化很大程度上体现在词汇和分布上：一个简单的5-gram模型就能很好地重现跨儿童模式（r=0.91）。相对于在单个儿童输入上训练，使用多个儿童的数据训练能明显提升对混合保留语言的预测能力，但在语法基准测试上没有同样明显的改善。在不同数据规模下，自然和合成训练输入也产生了不同的语法和词汇语义模式，并在语法现象上存在重要差异。综合这些结果，小型数据语言学习不仅取决于模型接触的语言量，还取决于其来源以及输入与模型预测任务之间的匹配程度。

articles.title: A Quantitative Approach to Asch Conformity in Frontier Large Language Models
articles.abstract: The Asch conformity experiment has recently gained considerable attention as a way of measuring conformity in large language models (LLMs). While previous studies have focused on demonstrating conformity in LLMs, our work adds a further quantitative layer to this approach. Instead of sampling a frontier LLM on a suite of questions, our approach samples a single question repeatedly, leveraging the probabilistic nature of LLMs to produce a distribution of answers. In doing so, we can compare the distributions of answers before and after the model is presented with the manufactured consensus. Our experiments confirm that frontier LLMs do conform, reinforcing prior literature, and, through our distribution-to-distribution comparisons, provide additional quantitative data on the conditions that lead to conformity and the degree to which it occurs.
articles.titleCn: 一种关于前沿大型语言模型中阿希从众现象的定量方法
articles.abstractCn: 阿希从众实验最近成为衡量大型语言模型（LLM）从众行为的一种重要方法。虽然以往的研究主要集中于展示LLM的从众行为，我们的工作为这一方法增添了定量的维度。我们的方法不是对一系列问题进行前沿LLM采样，而是对单个问题进行重复采样，利用LLM的概率性质生成答案分布。通过这种方式，我们可以在模型展示人工共识前后比较答案分布。我们的实验证实前沿LLM确实存在从众行为，这强化了以往文献的观点，并通过分布到分布的比较，提供了关于导致从众行为条件以及从众程度发生的额外定量数据。

articles.title: Japanese Discourse Structure Analysis Based on Segmented Discourse Representation Theory Using LLMs
articles.abstract: Discourse parsing based on Segmented Discourse Representation Theory (SDRT) is crucial for capturing the structural dynamics of dialogues. However, most prior research focuses on English, and its effectiveness for Japanese remains unclear owing to the lack of Japanese SDRT corpora. To address this issue, we construct Japanese SDRT corpora by translating existing English SDRT corpora using an LLM. Through a comparative evaluation of prompt-based and fine-tuned LLMs, we show that the models achieve comparable performance between English and Japanese, suggesting the cross-lingual applicability of SDRT-based discourse parsing. In order to investigate why the English and Japanese parsers achieve similar performance, we conduct ablation analyses on discourse markers and contextual inputs. Our results reveal that most of the Japanese discourse markers we examined have little impact, and the models' predictions depend heavily on contextual discourse relations rather than on the content of the context clauses. This structural reliance might explain the comparable performance despite the substantial typological differences between English and Japanese.
