articles.titleCn: 基于LLMs的分割话语表征理论视角下的日语话语结构分析
articles.abstractCn: 基于分段话语表征理论（SDRT）的话语解析对于捕捉对话的结构动态至关重要。然而，以往的大多数研究集中于英语，由于缺乏日语SDRT语料库，其对日语的有效性尚不明确。为解决这一问题，我们通过使用大型语言模型（LLM）翻译现有的英语SDRT语料库来构建日语SDRT语料库。通过对比评估基于提示和微调的LLM，我们表明这些模型在英语和日语中实现了相当的性能，这表明基于SDRT的话语解析具有跨语言适用性。为了探究英语和日语解析器为何能达到相似性能，我们对话语标记和上下文输入进行了消融分析。我们的结果表明，我们所考察的大部分日语话语标记影响甚微，模型的预测严重依赖于上下文话语关系，而非上下文子句的内容。这种结构依赖性或许可以解释尽管英语和日语在类型学上存在显著差异，但性能却相当的原因。

articles.title: Balanced State Subspaces for Mamba-2 State Compression
articles.abstract: Mamba-2 compresses all context into a fixed-size recurrent state that dominates decoding memory and bandwidth. Existing compressors quantize state values or prune state coordinates, scoring each channel independently in the native basis. We examine trained Mamba-2 states and find that energy is almost rank-one, but the output does not read the energetic directions: energy concentrates in a bias-like direction accumulated by the recurrence, while the content the output reads lives in a low-dimensional subspace that is not aligned with the state's coordinates. Even output-aware scores are computed coordinate by coordinate, so they miss the directions that determine the input--output map. Compression should therefore target the write--read subspace rather than individual coordinates. We propose \method{}, a post-training transform that instantiates balanced truncation with full controllability and observability Gramians and applies the rotation exactly via Mamba-2's scalar-identity transition. Because the useful rank varies widely across layers, we further introduce HARP, which allocates ranks per layer from the Hankel spectrum and protects retrieval-sensitive layers, improving both perplexity and retrieval over uniform budgets. Calibration takes a single forward pass, an order of magnitude faster than GHOST's released protocol, with lower peak memory. With HARP, \method{} halves the state dimension at an average WikiText-2 perplexity increase of $0.3$ points ($1.8\%$) across 130M--2.7B, versus $1.6$ ($9.3\%$) for GHOST, and the gap widens at 25\% retention.
articles.titleCn: Mamba-2状态压缩的平衡状态子空间
articles.abstractCn: Mamba-2将所有上下文压缩成一个固定大小的循环状态，该状态主导了解码的内存和带宽。现有的压缩器量化状态值或剪枝状态坐标，在原始基底下独立评分每个通道。我们检查了训练好的Mamba-2状态，发现能量几乎是一维的，但输出并未读取这些高能量方向：能量集中在由递归累积的类似偏差的方向上，而输出读取的内容则存在于一个与状态坐标不匹配的低维子空间中。即使输出感知评分也是逐坐标计算的，因此它们错过了决定输入-输出映射的方向。因此，压缩应该针对写-读子空间，而不是单个坐标。我们提出了\method{}，这是一种训练后转换方法，通过全可控和可观测的Gramians实例化平衡截断，并精确地通过Mamba-2的标量-恒等转换应用旋转。由于有用秩在层之间差异很大，我们进一步引入了HARP，它按层从Hankel谱分配秩，并保护检索敏感层，从而在均匀预算下提高了困惑度和检索性能。校准只需要一次前向传递，比GHOST发布的协议快一个数量级，且峰值内存更低。使用HARP，\method{}在130M-2.7B范围内将状态维度减半，平均WikiText-2困惑度增加了0.3点（1.8%），而GHOST增加了1.6（9.3%），并且在25%保留率时差距进一步扩大。

articles.title: Structured Maps for Landmark-Based Route Instructions with LLMs
articles.abstract: To generate landmark-based route instructions, models must understand both map geometry and human landmark preferences. Although large language models (LLMs) show great abilities in language tasks, the best way to structure map data for these models is not yet established. This paper proposes a structured text representation for landmark selection tasks in route navigation, utilizing SVG format to encode spatial features. The structured text maintains a geometric connection with rendered map images, allowing language models to directly access spatial and semantic data. Using a new dataset created from human-written route descriptions and OpenStreetMap data, we evaluate models on two tasks: landmark selection at turns and around destinations. Experiments with five LLMs show that the proposed structured text input performs as well as or better than image-based PNG inputs. In addition, task-specific fine-tuning enables smaller local LLMs to effectively leverage map layouts to achieve high selection accuracy. These results demonstrate that structured text is an efficient and lightweight interface for spatial reasoning in human-oriented navigation.
articles.titleCn: 基于地标的路线指令中的LLM结构化地图
articles.abstractCn: 为了生成基于地标路线指引，模型必须理解地图几何形状和人类地标偏好。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在语言任务中展现出强大的能力，但为这些模型构建地图数据的最优结构尚未确定。本文提出了一种用于路线导航中地标选择任务的文本结构化表示方法，利用SVG格式编码空间特征。这种结构化文本与渲染的地图图像保持几何关联，使语言模型能够直接访问空间和语义数据。我们使用由人类编写的路线描述和OpenStreetMap数据创建的新数据集，在两个任务上评估模型：转弯处的地标选择和目的地周围的地标选择。五个LLM的实验表明，所提出的结构化文本输入表现与基于图像的PNG输入相当或更好。此外，针对特定任务的微调使较小的本地LLM能够有效利用地图布局，实现高选择精度。这些结果表明，结构化文本是人类导向导航中空间推理的高效且轻量级接口。

articles.title: Decoupling Consistency and Conflict across MLLM Layers for Fake News Detection
articles.abstract: The trustworthiness of Web content faces a growing threat from multimodal fake news. Real news usually shows aligned image-text semantics, while fake news often contains a few conflicts at varying levels, such as mismatches in objects, scenes, events, and claims. However, existing methods usually treat consistency and conflict in a coarse and static way, limiting their ability to capture sparse conflicts and adapt to varying conflict levels. Inspired by the distinct knowledge encoded across layers in large language models, we propose Multi-Level Consistency and Conflict Decoupling (MLCCD), which captures conflicts at different levels from different layers of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Specifically, we first use the MLLM's final decision representation to select visual and textual tokens relevant to the task, preventing irrelevant content from diluting sparse conflicts. Then, we preserve tokens whose representations change sharply between adjacent layers, capturing the knowledge each layer adds. Finally, we decouple this knowledge into consistency and conflict evidence and aggregate each across layers with its own router, adapting to varying conflict levels. Experiments on three benchmarks show that MLCCD outperforms existing methods.
articles.titleCn: 跨MLLM层解耦一致性与冲突以进行假新闻检测
articles.abstractCn: 网络内容可信度正面临多模态假新闻日益增长的威胁。真实新闻通常表现出图像与文本语义的一致性，而假新闻往往在不同层次上包含一些冲突，例如对象、场景、事件和声明的不匹配。然而，现有方法通常以粗粒度和静态的方式处理一致性和冲突，这限制了它们捕捉稀疏冲突和适应不同冲突水平的能力。受大型语言模型中跨层编码的独特知识启发，我们提出了多级一致性与冲突解耦（MLCCD）方法，该方法从多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的不同层中捕捉不同层次的冲突。具体而言，我们首先使用MLLM的最终决策表示来选择与任务相关的视觉和文本标记，防止无关内容稀释稀疏冲突。然后，我们保留在相邻层之间表示变化剧烈的标记，捕捉每一层添加的知识。最后，我们将这些知识解耦为一致性和冲突证据，并使用各自的路由器跨层聚合每个证据，以适应不同的冲突水平。在三个基准测试上的实验表明，MLCCD优于现有方法。

articles.title: QESChunker: A Single Objective Unifies Overlapping and Non-Overlapping Chunking for RAG
articles.abstract: Chunking is a fundamental preprocessing step in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), yet most existing chunkers rely primarily on heuristics. We introduce the Question--Evidence-Supervised Chunker (QESChunker), to our knowledge the first method for constructing static chunk indices from question--evidence supervision. QESChunker constructs document-specific chunk indices by optimizing over human-annotated or LLM-generated question--evidence pairs, without access to held-out test queries. We formulate non-overlapping and overlapping index construction through a unified question--evidence utility-maximization objective, turning chunking into a supervised combinatorial optimization problem. Under the non-overlap constraint, the objective decomposes over chunks and can be optimized exactly in polynomial time by dynamic programming. When overlap is allowed, the objective becomes monotone submodular; exact optimization is NP-hard, but our greedy achieves a $(1-1/\sqrt{e})$-approximation. Across two self-constructed and three public datasets, both variants outperform existing chunking methods in complete-evidence recall in nearly all evaluated settings, under the same overlap regime and a fixed hybrid retriever. These results recast chunking as supervised, budget-aware index construction for evidence retrieval.
articles.titleCn: QESChunker：单一目标统一重叠与非重叠分块方法，用于RAG
articles.abstractCn: 分块是检索增强生成（RAG）中的基本预处理步骤，然而大多数现有的分块器主要依赖启发式方法。我们介绍了问题-证据监督分块器（QESChunker），据我们所知，这是首个从问题-证据监督中构建静态分块索引的方法。QESChunker通过优化人类标注或大型语言模型生成的问答对，构建特定文档的分块索引，而无需访问保留的测试查询。我们通过统一的问题-证据效用最大化目标，将非重叠和重叠索引构建问题形式化，将分块转化为监督组合优化问题。在非重叠约束下，目标可以分解到各个分块上，并可以通过动态规划在多项式时间内精确优化。当允许重叠时，目标变为单调次模，精确优化是NP-hard问题，但我们的贪婪算法达到了$(1-1/\sqrt{e})$近似解。在两个自建和三个公开数据集上，在相同的重叠机制和固定的混合检索器下，两种变体在几乎所有评估设置中都优于现有的分块方法，在完整证据召回率方面表现更优。这些结果将分块重新定义为证据检索的监督、预算感知索引构建问题。

articles.title: PRISM-BENCH: Diagnosing Grounded and Faithful Multimodal Reasoning Beyond Final-Answer Accuracy
articles.abstract: Final-answer accuracy reports whether a vision-language model was right, but not whether its answer was grounded in the image, whether its stated reasoning reflects that evidence, or what the answer cost to produce. Those are the properties that decide whether a system can be deployed. We present PRISM-BENCH, a benchmark of 1,000 expert-curated questions spanning five under-represented reasoning categories, in which every item carries an idealized reasoning trace written by one human annotator and validated by another. The traces support two diagnostics that accuracy cannot provide. A perception probe, in which the model answers from a description it wrote itself, attributes roughly 85% of frontier-model failures to misperception and places the bottleneck at grounding. Trace alignment predicts answer correctness for all 25 systems tested (macro AUROC 0.66) and survives length control, so it measures reasoning content and not verbosity. We further introduce CORE, an efficiency-aware metric that reorders 24.2% of model pairs relative to accuracy while remaining uncorrelated with response length. Across 25 open and closed systems, including GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4.6, the best accuracy is 66.0%. On the four categories with a human baseline the best system trails humans by 18.4 points, and recent frontier gains fall on recognition and not on spatial grounding.

articles.titleCn: PRISM-BENCH：超越最终答案准确性的基础与忠实多模态推理诊断
articles.abstractCn: 最终答案准确率报告一个视觉语言模型是否正确，但无法判断其答案是否基于图像、其陈述的推理是否反映证据，或生成答案的成本。这些才是决定系统是否可以部署的属性。我们提出了PRISM-BENCH，这是一个包含1000个由专家精选的问题的基准，涵盖五个推理类别中代表性不足的领域，其中每个项目都包含一个由一个人标注并由另一个人验证的理想化推理轨迹。这些轨迹支持两种准确性无法提供的诊断方法。感知探测中，模型根据自己编写的描述回答，将约85%的前沿模型失败归因于感知错误，并将瓶颈定位在基础层面。轨迹对齐预测了所有25个测试系统的答案正确性（宏观AUROC为0.66），并且不受长度控制，因此它衡量的是推理内容而非冗长性。我们进一步引入了CORE，这是一个考虑效率的指标，相对于准确性重新排序了24.2%的模型对，同时与响应长度不相关。在25个开放和封闭系统中，包括GPT-5和Claude Opus 4.6，最佳准确率为66.0%。在四个有人类基线的类别中，最佳系统落后于人类18.4分，最近的进步集中在识别而非空间基础层面。

articles.title: Agentic Data Sampling Framework for Multilingual ASR via Linguistic-Aware Error-Driven Optimization
articles.abstract: Multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) has achieved rapid progress with large-scale pretrained models and multilingual speech corpora. Previous studies have proved the pivotal role of data sampling in multilingual ASR performance. However, existing sampling strategies largely rely on time-consuming manual, heuristic-based designs. To address this, we propose a linguistic-aware agentic data sampling framework that introduces a data sampling LLM agent into the multilingual ASR training loop. The agent is driven by a linguistically grounded rubric that analyzes ASR errors from phonological, morphological, and syntactic perspectives, and uses the resulting feedback together with training statistics, budget constraints, and algorithm profiles to select domain-level, sample-level, and token-level sampling strategies. This design turns evaluation results into adaptive data-selection decisions rather than treating WER/CER as final endpoints only. We conduct experiments on twelve Common Voice languages using Whisper-medium as the ASR backbone. The results show that our method achieves performance better than full-data training while using less training data and lower computational resources, and substantially accelerates training convergence compared to conventional sampling strategies.
articles.titleCn: 面向多语言语音识别的基于语言感知错误驱动优化的代理数据采样框架
articles.abstractCn: 多语言自动语音识别（ASR）在大型预训练模型和多语言语音语料库的支持下取得了快速进展。先前研究表明，数据采样在多语言ASR性能中起着关键作用。然而，现有的采样策略很大程度上依赖于耗时的人工启发式设计。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种语言感知的智能体数据采样框架，该框架将数据采样大型语言模型（LLM）智能体引入多语言ASR训练循环。该智能体由一个基于语言规则的标准驱动，从语音学、词法形态和句法等角度分析ASR错误，并将生成的反馈与训练统计数据、预算约束和算法特征相结合，以选择领域级、样本级和词汇级采样策略。这种设计将评估结果转化为自适应数据选择决策，而不仅仅是将词错误率（WER）/字符错误率（CER）视为最终终点。我们在十二种Common Voice语言上使用Whisper-medium作为ASR主干进行了实验。结果表明，我们的方法在使用更少训练数据和更低计算资源的情况下，实现了优于全数据训练的性能，并且与传统的采样策略相比，显著加速了训练收敛。

articles.title: RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding
articles.abstract: Recently, LLM-based autonomous agents have shown strong capabilities in iteratively generating, evaluating, and refining executable solutions. In robotic manipulation, Code-as-Policy lets these agents search over modular and editable robot programs. However, effective program search requires physical understanding: agents must understand how objects can be manipulated, how scene geometry constrains actions, and why interactions succeed or fail. Existing methods rely mainly on execution feedback for program refinement, often leaving these physical questions unresolved. We introduce RoboAuto, a framework for robot program search that explicitly organizes physical understanding at the object, scene, and interaction levels through three components. First, a hierarchical knowledge base combines executable skills with object-centric knowledge of affordances, spatial relations, and action effects, learned from embodied data and online task solving. Second, scene grounding connects this knowledge to the current environment by identifying relevant objects and resolving action-critical quantities. Third, multi-stage planning with self-designed experiments checks whether each stage produces its expected physical effects and actively tests competing hypotheses to resolve physical uncertainties. RoboAuto achieves superior performance across five benchmark families, attaining an 89.1% success rate on short-horizon LIBERO-PRO tasks and more than twice the mean success rate of ASPIRE on LIBERO-PRO Long and LIBERO-Plus. It also outperforms ASPIRE and $π_{0.5}$ on three challenging long-horizon real-robot tasks requiring precise manipulation. We further show that the knowledge base transfers across simulators and embodiments, and that program search performance scales with its size. Project page: https://roboauto-ai.github.io/
articles.titleCn: RoboAuto：基于多级物理理解的自主机器人程序搜索
articles.abstractCn: 近期，基于大型语言模型的自主智能体在迭代生成、评估和优化可执行解决方案方面展现出强大能力。在机器人操作领域，代码即策略（Code-as-Policy）允许这些智能体在模块化和可编辑的机器人程序中进行搜索。然而，有效的程序搜索需要物理理解：智能体必须理解物体如何被操作、场景几何如何限制动作，以及交互为何成功或失败。现有方法主要依赖执行反馈来优化程序，往往无法解决这些物理问题。我们引入了RoboAuto，这是一个机器人程序搜索框架，通过三个组件明确地在物体、场景和交互层面组织物理理解。首先，分层知识库将可执行技能与从具身数据和在线任务解决中学习到的以物体为中心的知识（如可供性、空间关系和动作效果）相结合。其次，场景关联将此知识连接到当前环境，通过识别相关物体并解决动作关键量来实现。第三，多阶段规划通过设计实验来检查每个阶段是否产生预期的物理效果，并主动测试竞争假设以解决物理不确定性。RoboAuto在五个基准测试系列中取得了优异性能，在短期LIBERO-PRO任务上达到89.1%的成功率，并在LIBERO-PRO Long和LIBERO-Plus任务上比ASPIRE的平均成功率高出两倍以上。它还在三个需要精确操作的具有挑战性的长期真实机器人任务中超越了ASPIRE和$π_{0.5}$。我们进一步证明，知识库可以在模拟器和具身系统之间迁移，并且程序搜索性能随其规模的增长而提升。项目页面：https://roboauto-ai.github.io/

articles.title: ETC-Bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluation-Side Transcript Canonicalization
articles.abstract: Written transcripts of the same speech can differ in ways that are not uniquely determined by the speech signal. We formulate evaluation-side transcript canonicalization (ETC), which maps multiple surface forms to a single canonical form when their differences are not determined by speech. To our knowledge, ETC-Bench is the first and most comprehensive multilingual benchmark for evaluation-side transcript canonicalization, covering 181 phenomenon types across 12 languages. Each instance is a minimal pair that shares a sentence context and differs only in a target span exhibiting one phenomenon. To evaluate both canonicalization success and semantic preservation, we propose Semantic-preserving Exact-match Normalization Accuracy (SENA), which combines exact agreement between independently canonicalized pair members with a pair-relative BERTScore constraint against information loss. We further introduce the Taxonomy-guided Agent Canonicalization Skill (TACS), which provides LLM agents with phenomenon descriptions and explicit canonicalization contracts. Experiments with five baseline configurations and three TACS-based agents show that the agents outperform the baseline systems on shared languages. ETC-Bench provides a systematic testbed for evaluation-side transcript canonicalization across languages.
articles.titleCn: ETC-Bench：一个用于评估端转录规范化的多语言基准
articles.abstractCn: 相同演讲的书面文本可能存在不由语音信号唯一决定的差异。我们提出了评估端文本规范化（ETC），当差异不由语音决定时，将多种表面形式映射到单一规范形式。据我们所知，ETC-Bench是首个也是最全面的评估端文本规范化多语言基准，涵盖12种语言中的181种现象类型。每个实例是一个最小对，共享句子上下文，仅在表现出一种现象的目标片段上存在差异。为了评估规范化成功和语义保留，我们提出了保留语义的精确匹配规范化准确率（SENA），它结合了独立规范化的对成员之间的精确一致性与对相对BERTScore约束以防止信息丢失。我们进一步引入了基于分类的代理规范化技能（TACS），它为大型语言模型代理提供现象描述和明确的规范化合同。使用五种基线配置和三种基于TACS的代理进行的实验表明，代理在共享语言上优于基线系统。ETC-Bench为跨语言的评估端文本规范化提供了系统化的测试平台。

articles.title: Causal Localization of Evidence Effects in Transformers
articles.abstract: Can controlled symbolic inputs reveal attention heads that influence a language model's decisions from natural language evidence? We introduce controlled evidence aggregation (CEA), which varies the counts and order of two symbols in otherwise fixed prompts and measures changes in a frozen Transformer's preference between two answer tokens. The preference is measured by their logit difference; the prompts prescribe no correct answer. Balanced utility causal selection (BUC) identifies compact head sets by jointly evaluating how much ablating their outputs removes the count effect and how closely patching mean outputs between count conditions recovers the effect in both directions. We derive conditional bounds linking head attribution to intervention effects and specifying when the attribution shortlist can be recovered from finite samples. In Pythia-410M, ablating sets of 1-12 heads selected separately for four ordering regimes removes 65.5-91.6% of the count effect. The sets retain their influence on count comparisons not used for selection. To test relevance beyond symbolic inputs, we evaluate a natural language task asking which state is supported by more reports. Ablating eight heads selected only on symbolic yes/no prompts lowers mean accuracy by 8.2 percentage points, versus 0.8 for random sets matched by size and layer. Our results demonstrate that controlled symbolic probes can identify compact attention head sets whose causal influence extends to natural language decisions.
articles.titleCn: Transformer中证据效应的因果定位
articles.abstractCn: 可控符号输入能否从自然语言证据中揭示影响语言模型决策的注意力头？我们引入了可控证据聚合（CEA），该方法在固定提示中改变两个符号的数量和顺序，并测量冻结Transformer在两个答案标记之间的偏好变化。偏好通过它们的逻辑差异来衡量；提示并未规定正确答案。平衡效用因果选择（BUC）通过联合评估移除其输出的数量效应程度以及补丁计数条件之间的平均输出如何恢复双向效应，来识别紧凑的头部集合。我们推导出将头部归因与干预效应联系起来的条件界限，并指定何时可以从有限样本中恢复归因短名单。在Pythia-410M中，分别针对四种排序机制单独选择的1-12头部集合移除的数量效应为65.5-91.6%。这些集合在未用于选择的计数比较中仍保持其影响。为了测试符号输入之外的关联性，我们评估了一个自然语言任务，该任务询问哪个状态得到更多报告的支持。仅基于符号是/否提示选择的八个头部降低了平均准确率8.2个百分点，而随机匹配大小和层级的集合仅降低了0.8个百分点。我们的结果表明，可控符号探针可以识别其因果影响扩展到自然语言决策的紧凑注意力头部集合。

articles.title: Benchmarking Task Takeover Across Agent Handoffs
articles.abstract: As agents collaborate on longer tasks, responsibility may pass between models before the work is complete. The receiving model must build on prior decisions, observations, and actions while addressing the remaining requirements. Evaluating this transition requires connecting the information preserved at handoff to how the receiver continues the work, a relationship that task-success and memory-retention scores alone do not capture. We introduce the Handoff State Continuity Benchmark (HSC-Bench), comprising 1,039 tasks that evaluate two complementary aspects of task takeover: recovering relevant repository evidence and continuing from established conversational, tool, and file-work state. Comparisons across six receiving models show that structured handoff state improves repository evidence recovery for every model and continuation performance for most models. The strongest receivers differ between the two tracks, showing that evidence-recovery rankings alone do not characterize performance when continuing from inherited state. By combining these comparisons with checks of subsequent responses and actions, HSC-Bench evaluates both access to prior evidence and adherence to established commitments and completed work. This provides a basis for selecting receiving models and assessing handoff representations according to the work that must be carried forward.
articles.titleCn: 代理交接中的任务接管基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 随着代理在更长时间的任务中协作，责任可能在任务完成前在不同模型之间转移。接收模型必须基于先前的决策、观察和行动，同时处理剩余的要求。评估这种转换需要将交接时保留的信息与接收者如何继续工作联系起来，而任务成功和记忆保持分数本身无法捕捉这种关系。我们引入了交接状态连续性基准（HSC-Bench），它包含1039个任务，评估任务接管的两方面互补特性：恢复相关存储库证据和从已建立的对话、工具和文件工作状态继续。对六个接收模型的比较表明，结构化的交接状态提高了每个模型的存储库证据恢复能力，并提升了大多数模型的继续性能。在两个方向上表现最强的接收者有所不同，这表明在从继承状态继续时，仅凭证据恢复排名并不能表征性能。通过将这些比较与后续响应和行动的检查相结合，HSC-Bench评估了先前证据的获取以及对既定承诺和已完成工作的遵守情况。这为选择接收模型和根据必须继续的工作评估交接表示提供了基础。

articles.title: Folding Attention Biases into Keys Makes Compacted KV Caches Run on Standard Kernels
articles.abstract: Attention Matching (AM) compacts a KV cache by keeping some keys per head, refitting their values and adding a bias to each kept key's logit. FlashAttention and vLLM's paged caches have no input for it. We fold the bias into the keys along one closed-form direction per head, fitted on context queries, giving a plain cache with AM's size and head dimension and the model's own query path; the output error is bounded by how far each query's projection on that direction is from 1. With equal per-head budgets, unmodified vLLM serves folded caches through a KV connector, matching Hugging Face's answers on all 51 Qwen3-4B questions and its greedy output on 180 of 200 Qwen3-14B LongBench samples. With equal budgets on QuALITY (Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and LongHealth (three Qwen3 models), the fold is within noise of AM's accuracy in 13 of 14 settings, with lower KL to the full cache than dropping the bias in all 12 where both ran. Under the published per-head budgets, on Qwen3-4B, its Instruct-2507 variant and Llama-3.1-8B, it is within noise of AM in 9 of 10, no longer beats dropping the bias in KL, and the two each win once in accuracy.
articles.titleCn: 将注意力偏差融入键中使紧凑型KV缓存能在标准核上运行
articles.abstractCn: 注意力匹配（AM）通过每个头保留部分键来压缩KV缓存，重新拟合这些键的值，并为每个保留的键的logit添加偏差。FlashAttention和vLLM的页式缓存没有它的输入。我们将偏差沿每个头的一个封闭形式方向折叠到键中，该方向基于上下文查询拟合，从而得到一个与AM大小和头维度相同，并包含模型自身查询路径的简单缓存；输出误差由每个查询在该方向上的投影与1的距离所限制。在每头预算相等的情况下，未修改的vLLM通过KV连接器服务折叠缓存，在所有51个Qwen3-4B问题上匹配Hugging Face的答案，并在200个Qwen3-14B LongBench样本中的180个上匹配其贪婪输出。在QuALITY（Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B、Llama-3.1-8B）和LongHealth（三个Qwen3模型）上，等预算下，在14个设置中的13个中，折叠的精度在AM的噪声范围内，在12个同时运行的设置中，其KL散度低于完全缓存中丢弃偏差的情况。在已发布的每头预算下，在Qwen3-4B、其Instruct-2507变体和Llama-3.1-8B上，在10个设置中的9个内接近AM的精度，KL散度不再优于丢弃偏差，且两者在精度上各胜一次。

articles.title: MedConstBench: Benchmarking How Constitutions Steer LLMs in Medical Ethics
articles.abstract: As large language models advance rapidly, they are increasingly used to answer medical questions, and many such models are now deployed locally. Once a model is deployed, its behavior is governed mainly by the ethical policy written into its constitution. However, most existing work focuses on factual correctness rather than the trade-off between competing ethical values. Even benchmarks that do evaluate ethics treat it as a fixed property of the model rather than as a variable, so how a constitution reshapes medical-ethics behavior remains largely unexplored. We introduce MedConstBench, a medical-ethics benchmark that treats the deployment constitution as a controlled variable, is organized around Beauchamp's four principles, and is scored by human-calibrated multi-model peer review. It includes MedDilemma, our own dataset of clinical dilemmas, and supports a systematic analysis of how constitutions steer LLMs. Evaluating ten open-source LLMs under four constitutions, we find that the effect of a constitution is dimension-selective and model-dependent, and that no constitution is universally optimal. Motivated by these findings, we propose a do-no-harm adaptive selector that chooses a constitution per model, matching the per-model oracle while guaranteeing a worst-case floor and generalizing to unseen models at low cost.
articles.titleCn: MedConstBench：基准测试宪法如何引导大型语言模型在医学伦理方面的行为
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型的快速发展，它们越来越多地被用于回答医学问题，并且许多此类模型现在已部署在本地。一旦模型被部署，其行为主要由写入其宪章的伦理政策所规范。然而，大多数现有工作都侧重于事实准确性，而不是竞争性伦理价值之间的权衡。即使是评估伦理的基准也将其视为模型的固定属性，而不是变量，因此宪法如何重塑医学伦理行为仍然很大程度上未被探索。我们介绍了MedConstBench，这是一个将部署宪法视为受控变量的医学伦理基准，围绕贝克汉普的四项原则组织，并由人类校准的多模型同行评审进行评分。它包括MedDilemma，这是我们自己的临床困境数据集，并支持对宪法如何引导大型语言模型进行系统性分析。在四种宪法下评估十个开源大型语言模型，我们发现宪法的影响具有维度选择性和模型依赖性，并且没有一种宪法是普遍最优的。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了一种不造成伤害的自适应选择器，它为每个模型选择宪法，匹配每个模型的预言机，同时保证最坏情况下的底线，并以低成本泛化到未见过的模型。

articles.title: Do AI Scientists Know What's New?
articles.abstract: A major challenge facing AI scientific discovery pipelines is how to determine when a generated idea is meaningfully novel. Ideally, novelty checks in these pipelines must be able to reject non-novel ideas while not rejecting too many novel ideas, and they should also be able to distinguish which parts of a proposal are non-novel, as opposed to opaquely discarding entire proposals. We design an analytical framework for evaluation of novelty checks with temporal ground truth at both the proposal- and claim-level, using four datasets of 1,060 proposals built from published papers, reviewer disputes, and generated ideas matching ones the field went on to publish. Auditing existing novelty checks with this framework, we find that checks with high rejection rates on non-novel work also tend to have high false alarms on ideas that are later realized by human researchers, and observe that checks built to evaluate proposals as a whole can point to claim-level prior art only by rejecting the whole proposal. We therefore introduce ClaimNov, a fine-grained, interpretable claim-level novelty module. ClaimNov catches 97% of disguised papers at a 1.5% false-alarm rate, and its claim-level novelty profile cuts the LLM judge's false alarms from 11.8% to 1.5%. Because its verdict rests on claim-level evidence, ClaimNov also keeps proposals that build on established contributions, rejecting only 3% of ICLR-accepted proposals with a reviewer-disputed contribution and keeping 91 of 100 novel proposals with one spliced prior contribution, against 76 for the strongest existing check. Code and data are available at https://github.com/emmatliu/claimnov.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能科学家了解最新动态吗？
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能科学发现流程面临的一大挑战是如何判断一个生成的想法是否具有实质性的新颖性。理想情况下，这些流程中的新颖性检查必须能够拒绝非新颖的想法，同时又不至于拒绝过多新颖的想法，并且还应该能够区分提案中哪些部分是非新颖的，而不是含糊地否定整个提案。我们设计了一个分析框架，用于评估具有提案级和声明级时间真实标签的新颖性检查，该框架基于从已发表论文、审稿人争议以及与该领域后续发表内容相匹配的生成想法构建的四个数据集（共1,060个提案）。通过该框架审计现有的新颖性检查，我们发现那些对非新颖工作具有高拒绝率的检查也倾向于对后来由人类研究人员实现的想法产生大量误报，并且观察到，旨在整体评估提案的检查只能通过拒绝整个提案来指出声明级先例。因此，我们引入了ClaimNov，一个细粒度、可解释的声明级新颖性模块。ClaimNov能够以1.5%的误报率捕获97%的伪装论文，并且其声明级新颖性特征将LLM裁判者的误报率从11.8%降至1.5%。由于其判断基于声明级证据，ClaimNov也保留了基于既有贡献的提案，仅拒绝3%具有审稿人争议贡献的ICLR接受提案，并保留了91个具有拼接先例贡献的100个新颖提案，而最强的现有检查仅保留了76个。代码和数据可在https://github.com/emmatliu/claimnov获取。

articles.title: AC-JEPA: Anchored Cross-Modal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Visual-to-Symbolic Translation
articles.abstract: Cross-modal translation requires models to capture shared semantics across modalities while preserving the fine-grained structure required by the target modality. Yet in real-world scientific domains, paired data are often imperfect, while obtaining clean pairs at scale is costly. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) directly optimizes cross-modal translation through categorical token-level supervision, but this objective is sensitive to errors in the target sequences. JEPA offers a complementary representation-space objective, but most existing formulations focus on prediction within a modality rather than translation across modalities. We introduce Anchored Cross-Modal JEPA (AC-JEPA), an SFT-compatible plug-in that predicts masked intermediate states in both cross-modal directions using paired data. The joint-embedding objective targets cross-modal structure predictable from context, while the causal SFT path retains direct token-level supervision for the target sequence. During self-training, AC-JEPA learns from continuous latent targets derived from imperfect pseudo-labeled pairs, offering intrinsic tolerance to local data errors without promoting pseudo-tokens to hard categorical supervision. Using optical chemical structure recognition as a testbed, AC-JEPA trained on clean pairs achieves 76.07% accuracy on the Simple set of the WildMol benchmark, compared with 67.40% for SFT alone. Using the same pseudo-labeled data for both approaches, AC-JEPA-based self-training further raises accuracy to 80.23%, whereas accuracy under direct SFT drops from 67.40% to 63.47%. These results support SFT-anchored joint-embedding prediction as an effective strategy for cross-modal translation under both curated and imperfect supervision.
articles.titleCn: AC-JEPA：锚定跨模态联合嵌入预测架构，用于视觉到符号的翻译
articles.abstractCn: 跨模态翻译要求模型在保持目标模态所需精细结构的同时，捕捉跨模态的共享语义。然而在现实科学领域，成对数据往往不完美，而获取大规模干净成对数据成本高昂。有监督微调（SFT）通过分类级别的标记级监督直接优化跨模态翻译，但这一目标对目标序列中的错误敏感。JEPA提供了一种互补的表示空间目标，但现有的大多数公式侧重于模态内的预测而非跨模态的翻译。我们引入了锚定跨模态JEPA（AC-JEPA），这是一种与SFT兼容的插件，它使用成对数据预测两个跨模态方向的掩码中间状态。联合嵌入目标针对从上下文中可预测的跨模态结构，而因果SFT路径保留了目标序列的直接标记级监督。在自训练过程中，AC-JEPA从由不完美的伪标记成对数据派生的连续潜在目标中学习，从而在不将伪标记提升为硬分类监督的情况下，提供对局部数据错误的内在容忍。以光学化学结构识别作为测试平台，AC-JEPA在干净成对数据上训练，在WildMol基准的Simple集上达到76.07%的准确率，而单独SFT的准确率为67.40%。使用相同伪标记数据进行两种方法，基于AC-JEPA的自训练进一步将准确率提高到80.23%，而直接SFT的准确率从67.40%下降到63.47%。这些结果表明，以SFT锚定的联合嵌入预测是跨模态翻译在编辑和缺陷监督下的一种有效策略。

articles.title: A Heart Means Recursion: Exploring Visual Meaning and Communication in VLMs
articles.abstract: Do vision-language models (VLMs) share our ability to communicate visually? We share preliminary findings, starting from a surprising observation: simple visual symbols like a red heart can strongly influence model behavior on seemingly unrelated tasks, such as steering models towards recursive solutions on simple coding problems. Notably, this steering effect is largely implicit, as models' direct interpretations and thinking traces about visual symbols diverge substantially from their observed behavior. In visual communication between models, this leads to a generation--interpretation gap: while models tend to send shape primitives that they (and humans) find intuitive, these visual cues often fail to steer other models. In further communication games involving abstract concepts and stories, models can creatively use visuals to transmit meaning to one another, although some communications remain non-intuitive to humans. These findings reveal that VLMs might be capable of rich, creative, and visually-grounded communication, but their interpretation and production of visual meaning diverges from human conventions in surprising ways. Together this work highlights both the promise and challenges of visual communication between humans and VLMs.
articles.titleCn: 一颗心意味着递归：探索视觉语言模型中的视觉意义与沟通
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）是否具备我们视觉交流的能力？我们分享初步发现，始于一个惊人的观察：简单的视觉符号（如红色爱心）能显著影响模型在看似无关任务上的行为，例如引导模型在简单编程问题上寻求递归解决方案。值得注意的是，这种引导效应很大程度上是隐性的，因为模型对视觉符号的直接解释和思维轨迹与其行为表现存在巨大差异。在模型间的视觉交流中，这导致了生成-解释的差距：虽然模型倾向于发送它们（和人类）认为直观的形状基元，但这些视觉线索往往无法引导其他模型。在涉及抽象概念和故事的进一步交流游戏中，模型能创造性地使用视觉元素相互传递意义，尽管某些交流对人类而言仍不直观。这些发现表明，VLMs或许能够进行丰富、创造且基于视觉的交流，但它们对视觉意义的解释和生产方式与人类规范存在令人惊讶的差异。这项工作共同揭示了人类与VLMs之间视觉交流的潜力和挑战。

articles.title: CONCUR: Concordant Auxiliary Rewards for Multi-Task, Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: When a Large Language Model (LLM) is trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) on multiple tasks, a task's primary reward can gate auxiliary rewards such as a length reward: on a failing response, an auxiliary cannot exceed the primary. However, group-relative advantage estimators treat a gated auxiliary like any other component, so it can reverse the primary's order, and at the primary's ceiling only auxiliaries order responses. Keeping gated auxiliaries hurts some tasks, while dropping them hurts others. We propose CONCUR, an advantage estimator that replaces the standardized scores of each gated auxiliary with the closest scores that satisfy two conditions: responses with higher primary rewards cannot receive lower scores, and responses at the primary's ceiling receive equal scores. CONCUR-T applies both conditions throughout training, and CONCUR-A lifts the second for an auxiliary that agrees with the primary's order more often than it reverses it among passing responses. On three models from two families and across math, code, instruction following, and writing, both variants score higher on average than all baselines and than when all the gated auxiliaries are dropped.
articles.titleCn: CONCUR：用于多任务、多奖励强化学习的协同辅助奖励
articles.abstractCn: 当一个大型语言模型（LLM）通过强化学习（RL）在多个任务上进行训练时，一个任务的主要奖励可以控制辅助奖励（如长度奖励）：在失败响应中，辅助奖励不能超过主要奖励。然而，相对优势估计器将受控的辅助奖励视为任何其他组件，因此它可能逆转主要奖励的顺序，并且在主要奖励的上限时只有辅助奖励排序响应。保留受控的辅助奖励会损害某些任务，而移除它们则会损害其他任务。我们提出了CONCUR，一种优势估计器，它用满足两个条件的最近分数替换每个受控辅助奖励的标准化分数：具有更高主要奖励的响应不能获得较低的分数，而在主要奖励的上限处的响应获得相等的分数。CONCUR-T在整个训练过程中应用这两个条件，而CONCUR-A则对那些比逆转主要奖励顺序更频繁地同意主要奖励顺序的辅助奖励移除第二个条件。在两个家族中的三个模型上，跨越数学、代码、指令遵循和写作任务，两个变体在平均得分上都高于所有基线，并且高于移除所有受控辅助奖励的情况。

articles.title: No Tokenizer, Still a Gap: Cross-Lingual Fairness of Homoglyph and Invisible-Character Watermarking
articles.abstract: Homoglyph and invisible-character watermarks are edit-based watermarks. Instead of changing how a model generates text, they hide a signal in the text after it is written. They swap some characters for homoglyphs, which look the same, or very similar, but have different Unicode code points, or they insert characters that do not display, all without access to the model that wrote the text. Generation-time watermarks work less well for lower-resourced languages due to how tokenizers split their text. Because they work on individual characters, these watermarks never touch a tokenizer, so we ask whether they escape this gap. Across 40 language varieties in 24 scripts, we measure capacity (the hidden bits each character can carry), how much of it survives routine handling and targeted removal, and how much text a keyed detector needs. Capacity varies 3.3-fold and script accounts for 96\% of that variation. Within Latin script, resource level makes no detectable difference ($ρ=+0.095$, $p=0.78$), but across scripts capacity rises with it ($ρ=+0.54$, 95\% CI $[+0.14,+0.83]$), because lower-resourced languages tend to use scripts with few homoglyphs. Ordinary copy-paste, which strips invisible characters, widens the gap: a detector then needs about 2 code points of English or Persian but 93 of Lao. Removing the tokenizer does not remove the inequity, but instead only changes its source.
articles.titleCn: 无分词器，仍有差距：同形字符和不可见字符水印的跨语言公平性
articles.abstractCn: 同形字符和不可见字符水印是基于编辑的水印。它们不是改变模型生成文本的方式，而是在文本写入后隐藏信号。它们通过用看起来相同或非常相似但具有不同Unicode码点的同形字符替换某些字符，或者插入不显示的字符来进行隐藏，所有这些操作都不需要访问编写文本的模型。由于分词器如何分割文本，生成时水印在低资源语言中效果较差。因为这些水印作用于单个字符，所以它们永远不会接触分词器，因此我们质疑它们是否能够避开这个差距。在24种文字的40种语言变体中，我们测量了容量（每个字符可以携带的隐藏位数），有多少容量在常规处理和针对性移除后得以保留，以及密钥检测器需要多少文本。容量变化了3.3倍，文字解释了其中96%的变化。在拉丁文字中，资源水平没有可检测到的差异（ρ=+0.095，p=0.78），但在不同文字之间，容量随着资源水平上升（ρ=+0.54，95%置信区间[+0.14,+0.83]），因为低资源语言倾向于使用同形字符较少的文字。普通的复制粘贴（移除不可见字符）会扩大差距：此时检测器需要大约2个英文字符或波斯文字符，但需要93个老挝文字符。移除分词器并没有消除这种不平等，而是仅仅改变了其来源。
